reviewText: I was skeptical at first whether AmazonBasics would make an iPhone case that both looked good and was functional, but I knew as soon as I opened the box that this was an excellent choice.  The red is not as bright as the red in the picture (it's a darker, metallic red), and it looks much better than on this product page.  Yes, it has all the necessary cut-outs for the controls and camera, and yes, everything is easy to reach/use.  But that's not all this case offers.  It has a secure connection between top and bottom so the case doesn't accidentally open.  It feels great in the hand, with rounded edges and just enough rubberized texture to keep it from slipping out of your hand.  Although it is not difficult to remove and insert the iPhone, you have to use some pressure -- and that's good.  As with any case, it makes the iPhone slightly thicker, but I consider this on the slender end of case options.  Note:  this case does not fit the new iPhone4.This case definitely looks and feels more expensive than it is.  I love it -- it's much better than my similarly priced black rubberized case.  If you like the slippery feel of the iPhone without a case or how easy it is to slip into a pocket of tight jeans, you'll be disappointed.  However, if you want any kind of a case at all, this one is an excellent option to consider.  For a thicker, glossy case that also acts as a battery, check outMophie Juice Pack Air Case and Rechargeable Battery for iPhone.I love this case so much that I ordered more for the other iPhones in the house.-- Debbie Lee Wesselmann
summary: Inexpensive Case With a Great Feel and Look

reviewText: Cell phone cases can be a bit tricky to buy online since it is hard to judge how they will work from the pictures.  Fortunately, this is a case that looks great and performs very well at the same time.This AnazonBasics case is easy to put on and has a slightly 'rubberized' feel so it is easy to grip.  The case itself feels solid enough that it should hold up well to some abuse and doesn't feel like it will come apart and let the phone fall out.  All the buttons and ports on the phone are also easily accessible.Compared to other cases I've seen, I can't believe Amazon was able to create one this nice for such a low price!

This is a solid-built case, it fits my iphone 3gs perfectly and looks like it will offer a great deal of protection for the phone in case the phone gets dropped or something. This the 2nd case I bought for my phone, the 1st one was a overpriced Seidio case, it broke in three month.
this is the 3rd case that I have bought for my iphone. This one has no clips to break and is more sturdy than the soft silicone case. It works perfectly for a great price.

I have been fairly impressed with AmazonBasics products, and this iPhone case is no exception. In the past I have used both high-end and low-end iPhone cases. Even though this Amazon case does not have all the bells and whistles of the higher end ones from other manufacturers, it is definitely miles ahead of some cheap ones that I had tried out in the past. The case is sturdy, well designed and extremely easy to put on your iPhone. The texture of the case feels really good in your hand and it provides you with a solid and comfortable grip. My only complaint is that the area of the case around iPhone's "home" button is a bit too snug - it hinders your access to that button a bit. Other than that, this is a very good case and a great value for your money.
summary: A great value for the money

reviewText: I've used several cases and skins for my and my wife's iPhones over the last few years, and this is one of the better ones. It is similar in protective ability to my wife's preferred case,Apple iPhone 3G (Spring Flowers) Design Snap-On Case Cover, but is cheaper with some noticeable improvements. This case has a clever two piece, top and bottom halves which slide into each other solidly instead of having a front and back halves held together by iffy snaps. It also has a satiny, rubber texture which some might prefer for gripping over the hard plastic of the other case. One thing it doesn't have is any pattern or picture, it's a plain two color graphite bottom with deep red top.Installation was quick and easy, and looks to give the phone a good home. I carry my own phone in a gelaskin skin, which cost me $200 when my daughter dropped it, cracking the screen. I believe this case would protect the phone against much cracking danger. You will probably want to purchase a screen protector separately, as the iPhone 3G S does not have the hardened screen of an iPhone 4.
summary: Excellent Value for a Protective Case

reviewText: This case is just perfect for what I needed. It looks sleek and feels good in your hand. I love the texture...it feels like brushed steel. It goes on (or off) in a snap, VERY simple. All the ports are accessible so there is no need to remove the case for charging or to use accessories. Excellent value.

This Amazon Basics 3G / 3GS iPhone case does what it is supposed to do at a very reasonable price.The case is a two piece plastic design; the top portion appears somewhat metallic but it in fact plastic.  I appreciated the fact that the finish is a bit rubberized, allowing a good grip on the encased phone.  There are a few very thin rubber strips on the interior of the case that may aid in protecting the iPhone in case of a drop.  Cutouts on the top, sides, and bottom allow access to the necessary buttons and ports; my Apple docking cable, 3rd party docking cables, and 3rd party headphones fit without any issue.  And though I doubt you will be able to use any standard iPhone docks with this case, it is trivial to remove the case if you want to plug your iPhone into an Apple dock, Bose SoundDock, or other such device.My only small concern is that the two pieces are held together by friction only (nothing "snaps" together) and over time the two pieces might loosen up.  But in practice over the first month of use this has not been an issue.  Also, it may have been useful for Amazon to include a front screen protector; I've never used one, but many people seem to prefer having a bit of extra protection for the front glass.  Those quibbles aside, for the price I have no problem reccomending this case.
summary: Very good budget iPhone case from Amazon

reviewText: My wife goes through iPhone cases on a bimonthly basis.  So far her favorite has beenIncipio Feather Case for iPhone 3G, 3GS (Black).  However, that case costs 2x - 3.5x the price of this AmazonBasics Shell-Case.  So let's see if the Incipio is at least 2x better...Compared to the Incipio Feather Case:+ Slightly better protection for the iPhone+ Bright attractive color+ much cheaper+ Incipio's plastic starts peeling off in layers after a few months (we wash case occasionally).- slightly harder to put on- Very difficult to take off, hard to pull bottom out with iPhone in.- Color can scratch off with significant abuse- slightly bigger (1/4" taller and almost 1/8" thicker)Overall, I'd recommend this as the best iPhone case for the price, especially if you like the color and don't plan to remove the iPhone from the case too often.
summary: Cheap, Attractive, Hard to Take Off

reviewText: As the name "AmazonBasics" might imply, this is a fairly basic shell case for the iPhone 3G/3Gs.  I actually used mine with an iPod Touch 3G.Positives - the color is a nice deep shade.  It is easy to add / remove the device from the case as well.  Jacks are accessible.Negatives - the buttons may be more difficult to push once the case is in place.  This is true of many protective cases.  Many cases include a front-screen protector.  This one does not.Conclusion - not a bad value for the price point.

I got my iPhone 3GS relatively late in the game, as Apple just announced the iphone 4 yesterday.  Still, I needed something at the time (early April), and I've been looking around for a case.  Problem is everything I'd find didn't feel great, or was too bloody expensive.  That's a problem when buying things from iJobs.  A lot of it is expensive.  I'd been using some iPod socks I bought for my iPod touch a few years back on the iPhone.  It wasn't optimal, but at least it protected the thing from scratches and keys when not in use.Then I saw this case pop up.  I'm familiar with Amazon's Basics line already, having bought a bunch of blank media, and several cables from them.  So I took a shot and ordered this.  Glad I did, as it popped on nicely, and gives my iPhone a feel that doesn't make me think I'm going to drop it.  The red back has a slightly rubbery feel to it, just enough to give you a sense of grip, yet not enough where it grates on your fingers, or feels sticky.This is a nice quality case, and I would hope Amazon would make a similar thing for the iPad, too.  :)  I'd buy it in a second, this was a great cover.

nice grip...for the price it looks great you'd think you bought a 30 dollar case...but it's actually from amazon..which is a plus.  not bulky at all...the only negative is that on the edges of the case a little bit too raised to where it may get you to mess up while you're texting other than that it's nice ...

I love the color of this iPhone case- Its a nice smoky metallic red- The case went on great, and looks really nice. I have no complaints about this product, it's really great- The only thing that confused me as the box it came with was huge, they could have fit 10 cases in it, but that is fine, just kinda confused when I got this huge box for this little case. It was packaged great though, with they had more colors as I would purchase more of this simple nice looking cover for my iPhone! :)

I am very impressed with Amazon's version of iphone accessories. The Shell case I got for my iphone is just as nice as the one my husband purchased for quite a bit more than I did. The case has a silky feel to it and the color is a nice red without being too glaring or shiny. It is really easy to put on since in pops apart into two sections - one is the red bit and the other is the black one. The iphone goes inside and the pieces click together. You can charge or connect the iphone to cables without removing it. I do need to snap off the black section when putting the phone into my speaker/radio/ charger dock but that is really a minor detail to me. In brief. . . Love it!!
summary: nice silky feel and does it's job

reviewText: This product will perform it's described function, which is to protect your ipone3. Just remember that it is not for new iphone4 and is not compatible with it.

I had seen but never tried an Amazon Basics product until now.  Amazon Basics are the company's private label products that are appearing in a number of categories.  I had a prior InCase rubber case for my iPhone and when given the opportunity, decided to try out this case.  If you like a hard case for your phone this one is good, high quality with a tight fit and good materials.  The case provides ample protection for the iPhone adding almost no weight or bulk to your cell phone.The fit of the case to the phone is so good that a friend asked if I had a new phone!There are a few things that you should be aware of when choosing this case.  The shell case does add some thickness to the phone, particularly around the edges of the screen where there is a noticeable lip on the case.  The lip makes sense as that helps protect the screen, but if you are used to holding the phone in your hand and dialing the screen with the same thumb, you will notice the lip.The lip also makes turning the phone on and off different, as you have to push your finger down so enough of it reaches to the on/off button on the phone itself.  With a rubber case the button on the outside of the case turns it off.  It's not a big deal, but something to be aware of.Overall recommended, as it's a great value and high quality product.  If you are already happy with your existing case, then stick with that, but if you are considering a new case or your first case give this a serious look, as it's a first quality product.
summary: Good value and a viable choice for your iPhone

reviewText: This red and black plastic case has a nice metallic finish to it and makes your iPhone (3G or 3GS) look smart. But its main function should be to protect your expensive iPhone from bumps, scratches and even drops. It may help with that, but dropping your phone can easily crack the glass surface. Initially, I recommend the Incipio Technologies dermaSHOT Silicone Case for iPhone 3G, 3GS (Black). It's more substantial and rubberized. The outer layer is thicker with MUCH more impact protection. It's edges are wide enough that only a direct drop onto an object will crack the glass (within reason). However, the Incipio is more flexible and I found that with my iPhone in my back pocket, it was bending making the buzzer go off.  Now with the sturdier Shell-Case, I don't have to worry.  GO with the Shell-Case!

As a user of an InCase slim model for the past year, I was in the market for a new case for my iPhone. This case seemed to have all that I was looking for. The shock resistance is a plus, and the color is pretty snazzy, but the main problem I have with this phone is that the ridge surrounding the main button at the bottom of the iPhone's face is extremely annoying. It makes it a pain to push the button and is something I could just not get used to. If you don't mind having a ridge surrounding the main button, then go for this case. But if you can see that being potentially annoying for you, find a different one.

Great, simple, and elegant case. It looks a red iPhone. If the iPhone came in colors, this is what it would look like. The case fits really well and is very simple in design - this is what makes it great. For the money - it is simply the best case you can choose.
summary: Best case for the money. Period.

reviewerName: Nathan M. Rose "Movie Guy from FlickDirect"
reviewText: Each time a new iPhone comes out there is always a slew of cases that are released but they are usually sub-par. The unlikely case manufacture, Amazon, has now released the perfect case for your older iphone. The case breaks apart into two pieces however fits snug enough that it never comes off. As far as projection. I have tried dropped the phone from my hand onto tile and no breakage. If you are deciding on a case for your phone this is definitely it!
summary: Perfect Case for your old iPhone

reviewText: From a first look the case looks metallic, but it's really a hard rubber plastic.  Its two pieces: one black, the other dark red (carmine). You slide your iPhone into the top case and slide the bottom in to make a snug fit.  My iPhone feels really secure in my hands and very well protected.  I like this case better than the one piece silicon rubber unit I had.  I always felt like the silicon rubber would fall off, and wasn't giving my phone full protection. Plus, my 1 year old son likes to play with my phone and sometimes he slips the rubber off.  With this hard shell case my son cannot remove it.  One of the reasons I have a very secure fit, is because I use this screen protector:AmazonBasics Anti-Glare Screen Protector Film for iPhone 3G, 3GS, 3 pack.  It's really made my case and phone a solid unit. Definitely recommend both products.
summary: Awesome Case.  Love the feel and protection!

reviewText: This plastic case has a metal-like finish and looks great. It fits iPhone very well. I had soft thin rubber case. The problem with that is that it is too soft and thin. The case sometimes slips. This case is a little hard, but not too hard. I think it will absord the impact if I drops. Definitely I will try it to see how good it is for that. Because it is not soft, iPhone stays inside securely. The best part is that it is only five bucks! Highly recommended.

The Amazon Basics shell case for the iPhone works perfectly.  The bottom rubber portion detaches from the red plastic shell for easy installation, taking just a few seconds.The color is great (if you like metallic red that is).  It has a brushed metal-like finish and looks nice on the phone.  The sturdiness is excellent for a case at this price point (similar cases in the ATT stores are at least double the price of this one).The case also provides access to all the connectors and doesn't block the camera lens.  Overall, I feel confident that this case will prevent minor dings and scratches.

Five EXCELLENT Stars!  This red/black form-fitting rigid shell for the iPhone 3G and 3GS is a marvelous piece of armor. You simply open it by pulling loose the black bottom part, drop in the iPhone, top first, and securely close the black bottom part. It gives not only protection for the back and sides of the phone, but it also helps to keep the bottom from sliding around on a slick surface. All controls are accessible and there is no issue with camera lens, charging, headphones, and, in my case, use with the 2 different speaker/docks that I own. 1 year warranty. Highly Recommended. Five USEFUL Stars.

This iPhone case stands out as having had some real thought put into its design.  The bottom portion (black part) pulls off (with a bit of effort) for using the iPhone in a docking station.  I really like this feature. Be careful handling it without the bottom on it though, as the phone will slip out easily from the other part of the holder (the larger top portion.) The botton part stays on once it is put on. No fear of the bottom falling off by accident.It is a rigid case, lightweight, and durable-feeling. The back is semi-smooth. The friction caused by the back isn't so much that it is difficult to get it out of a pocket. It is not slippery like a metal case, but not rough like a plastic or rubber case either.Headphones plug into it with the case on, no problem.  Even my headphones that have a 90-degree angle near the jack fit in just fine.There are no button covers, just cut-outs where the buttons are that you would need to access the volume, on/off, and so on.It looks nicer than the image shows on Amazon. It almost looks like a brushed metal finish.

The up-side of the AmazonBasics iPhone cover is the hard shell, all over non-slip finish, it doesn't add a lot of bulk to the phone, and the price.  The down-side of this casing is that there are no protective pieces over the volume buttons, power socket, or on/off button.  Overall, it is a nice in-between solution perfect for someone working in an office or some other non-harsh environment.
summary: A great in-between solution--increased protection without adding bulk

reviewText: with this case, at this price!  We have paid three times as much for cases for our phone, and I would have to say that this one is easily comparable to cases we have spent $15-$20 on.A few things:Really like the color.  It has a nice, expensive looking matte finish to it, and you can never go wrong with red!It is very easy to use.  Pop the bottom off and slide it right up and over the phone.  Equally easy to remove.I really like the interior of the case.  There is a rubbery material in there to protect the phone and prevent scratches.All phone jacks are accessible, but the case makes some of the buttons hard to push-specifically the volume button and sleep button.  My fingers are smaller than my husband's and I seem to have less of a problem, though the volume buttons are definitely harder to get to because of the way the case angles down in that area.We aren't huge logo fans in my family, and there is a small Amazon Basic's logo on the back, near the bottom, and there is no screen protector included, but again for less than $6 dollars, this case is really a great little product.

Very soft leather, nice big magnetic clip closure, and a swivel belt clip, all for under $10 - excellent really.I'm not sure how long it's going to last, the swivel clip is a little stiff and clunky, and will probably be the first thing to break, but I like a complete "cover" type case to protect my phone, and it certainly looks stylish enough, without being too bulky.I didn't like the "Amazon Basics" stamped on the metal clasp on the front, but I guess it's no big deal.When comparing this to other products out there, it's very cheap in comparison, but not cheap in quality.A word on the frustration free packaging by the way: - this arrived in a small box, padded inside a much larger box around 30" x 16"?? -  talk about overkill for an unbreakable leather case only 6" long?Sometimes I don't get it, I have had high price electronics arrive with little or no protection at all in the mail, and this padded like a Fabergé egg? Funny really.

The new Amazon Leather Case for Blackberry looks and feels top notch. I like that it includes the Amazon logo - after all, it's my favorite store. The case comes with a 1 year manufacturer's warranty. The clip seems to work a lot better than other cases I've had over the years. My only concern is the magnet - personally it seems a little weak.

Want something inexpensive that will protect your $300 Blackberry Curve?  Then this AmazonBasics Leather Case will be right up your alley.  It a holster type case with a belt clip and magnetic clasp.  It seems quite well constructed and sturdy.  The belt clip fits snugly and the magnetic clasp seems to hold together pretty well.  Its attractive looking, the leather is nice, and overall the size isn't huge so you won't feel like your carrying a cement brick around on your belt.  For less than $10, I can't imagine you'd find many better cases for your Blackberry.

I ordered this as a gift for a family member that uses a BlackBerry.They seem to love this product except for the fact that it is missing a small magnet inside it that turns off the BlackBerry keypad,without this magnet the phones buttons can be pressed while inside the case and drain the battery.Other than this annoying fact the case is well made and does what it's supposed to,it holds the device snugly.The top of the case has a cover with a magnetic tip that snaps into place easily,so putting the phone in & getting it out is hassle free and can be done with one hand.If you simply must have a case that turns off the devices keypad when putting it in then you should skip this one,otherwise this is a great product with a low price.
summary: Perfect Product.....if it had a keypad magnet

reviewText: while yes this little case will hold your phone nicely and does look rather slick and so on it's still lacking a major aspect that all BlackBerry cases should have.I doesn't have a magnet in it that will actually turn off the key pad of the black berry phones.So no matter what you do, your phone will get buttons pushed and when you take it out to start talking you'll have a message saying would you like to assign this hot key... The only way around this it to lock your phones keypad before you put it in the holder. This kind of defeats the purpose of having the case then. There are several other just as cheap cases available that do this very thing.I don't see how Amazon could have left out such a key feature in the process of making these cases.While it does have a magnet clasp on the case to hold it closed it's not positioned right to turn off the keypad at the same time. Clearly whoever designed this case knows nothing about BlackBerry products and how they work in general.such a simple thing to implement and they didn't even do that... So very disappointing.
summary: looks nice and holds phone nicely BUT no keyboard magnet.

reviewText: Amazon offers a great product for an excellent price with this Amazon Basic Blackberry case. It has a soft leather case with sturdy stitching. Looks great for both clipped to a man's belt or a woman's purse strap. It has a strong clip that swivels 180 degrees to provide great flexibility. I love the magnetic clamp to safely secure your Blackberry. There is absolutely nothing to dislike about this case, especially for $7.99.
summary: Great product for an excellent price

reviewText: This soft leather case is pretty much as described.  It seems well made with good stitching.  The belt clasp seems strong enough, the flap I'm not so sure about,  Probably OK.  It looks like it would hold any regular style cell phone to me as well as a Blackberry Curve.  The price seems fair for this quality.  Rather nice looking overall.  I would have preferred just a leather loop for my belt, but the clasp is probably easier to use and more versatile.As another reviewer mentioned, for some odd reason this came in a nice small box inside a huge (by comparison) box stuffed with paper.Overall a nice item at a fair price that is well designed for its purpose.
summary: Nice item at a fair price.

reviewText: This case looks and feels like a more expensive item, and I'm sure if it were from another brand name it would indeed cost more.Also, if these various Amazon "Basics" items had fancy color hang card or box to attract your attention, they would be much more expensive as well.Quality,flawless leather, solid good looking stitching, with "Amazon Basics" emblem on flap.Inside is lined with a soft fabric to keep from scratching your phone.I feel that this could have a bit stronger magnet, but can't really say it's not strong enough to do the job.  Just seems to pull apart too easily. Might just be the price of these phones that make me feel I want more security.Belt clip has strong spring, and the detents to rotate it are tight and solid at each stopSold as a BlackBerry Curve case, but of course, you could put any phone (or electronic device) in this that fits it's listed dimensions.  Nothing on the case says "BlackBerry" etc.Nice item for a good price, Amazon just keeps expanding the "Basics" line with more and more items, good to see.Update; Note that this items price seems to go high now and then for some reason...I reviewed it at about twelve dollars, good at around the orginal price but not four times as much when the price jumps.  (if it does again)

Well I thought I would get this case for me - BUT my daughter saw it and claimed it for her cell.  She is 9 years old and it holds on her pants - for active child - this is the perfect test. It protects her cell very well and we have had it all summer and it still looks new.  Child Test Quality Approved!

The clip itself beats some other cases sold for the BlackBerry Curve. The most important part of such a unit might be the clip.  That's the part that clips to a belt or other anchor and simultaneously attached to the case and swivels horizontal or vertical. However, there is no magnet in the case to turn the Blackberry off - major problem.  A separate, minor issue is that the magnate in the clasp is not as strong as what I'm used to in other cases.Pros:*Clip - the part that attaches to belt and also the case and swivels, as described above.*Case itself - it's tight and secures the Curve well.*Logo - I prefer the AmazonBasics brand logo over other brand logos because Amazon is known for customer service.Cons:*No auto-shut off because no magnet in case to do that.*The magnate in the clasp is not strong.*The Blackberry Curve phone loads vertically into this holster, not horizontally. That makes it just a tiny bit more effort to unholster when answering a call.
summary: No Auto-Shut Off of Blackberry Curve When in Case

reviewText: Great price for a genuine leather lambskin leather case. It's really nice, soft leather with a magnetic closure and a rotating belt clip, though I keep mine clipped to the side of my purse.Fits other phones too because I use mine for my Nokia Mural phone and the case is slightly big for it but works great and keeps my phone secure.Definitely recommend, such a great price compared to the prices in the phone stores.Update: It's a year later and I still use this phone case. I use it attached to my purse and it still looks brand new and shows no signs of wear.

The Amazon Basics leather phone case is designed to hold a Blackberry Curve.  It's made of a soft feeling lamb skin leather with nice white stitching along all the edges.  The inside is a soft black felt like material.  The top flap is nice and heavy and magnetic with an "Amazon Basics" plate on the front.  It magnetizes down into an inset section of brown nylon type material.  It's belt clip is sturdy plastic and rotates 180 degrees.  All in all it is an attractive and well made case.

This is a nice quality leather case, but the magnetic holder isn't strong enough and comes open at times.  The sides don't hold the phone in well either so it ends up on the floor if I lay down and play with my son for a bit.  I prefer Velcro or snap tops on the case.  The second issue is the case will rotate parallel to the ground, but then I would be really worried about losing my phone.The material had no funny smells like a cheap case I bought off of an online auction site, and the snap is nice and firm and doesn't rotate too easily by itself.  For material quality I would give this a 4 or 5, but for my phone it doesn't work great.  Put a stronger magnet in it and slightly taller sides so the phone doesn't fall out, and it would be a winner.
summary: Quality Materials, but my Phone Doesn't Stay Put

reviewText: This is a good quality case for a very good price, which says value to me.Other folk may have tried to use this case with a phone other than the Blackberry Curve, and so have not gotten good results from it.For a case that is not sold by Blackberry (which would have the device control magnet in it, for example) this is very good design. This case holds my phone securely and pretty tightly so the magnetic flap is just kind of an afterthought. I prefer to lock the keyboard before putting in the case as I do not want it to pocket dial. I am concerned that the side pieces might put too much pressure on the side buttons (I have the iDEN version). However, those same side pieces allow the phone to stay secure while it is being used for phone or music playing as it does not interfere with the headset jack. I have used different casesOtterBox Defender Case for BlackBerry Curve 8300 Series (Black)for this phone and this one is a little classier looking than the stock case. I also usually keep my phone on vibrate and this case does not interfere with my being able to tell that is ringing. The clip is good in that it can attach to very wide belts (I usually wear one that is 1 & 3/4 inches wide) and the clip can rotate so you can wear it perpendicular or parallel to your belt. The logo is small and subtle, so it is pretty basic, which I like. Overall, I think it holds the phone more securely than the stock clip.The box it comes in is small and recyclable. The box that the smaller box came in was huge, at least it was recyclable.

This so very soft lambskin is perfect. It is designed to keep your phone free of scratches and very fashionable. I USE IT ON MY MOTOROLA FLIP PHONE TO CLIP TO MY POCKET OR STRAP TO MY BAG OR PURSE! One of the best features is the 180 degrees swiveling Belt Clip for Customized Fit. Designed to go where you go, it locks at six positions for a customized fit. The Guys love to clip on belt or pants pocket and girls on their purse or bag, clip it almost anywhere.  The case has a magnet closure to keep your BlackBerry Curve secure when not in use--it also gives you quick access to your phone when a call comes in. Comes with Amazon Frustration-Free Packaging just case and 1 year Limited Warranty.Buy it you will Love it.
summary: AWESOME for all ages male or female. A soft clipable Lambskin Leather case for Blackberry curve or other slim little phone.

reviewText: The case is well built and feels sturdy.  It has a strong magnetic flap that really locks the phone into place so that it won't fall out.  The clip on the back is well made.  Overall it is a solid case and worth the buy. Highly recommend.

This is a great case for my BlackBerry Curve.  It attaches nicely to the side of my purse using the sturdy clip.  The top is magnetized so that it sort of just pops close with a slight push and the entire case is leather.  It really is a very sturdy and classy looking case.  No plastic or junky, silly colors.  Just simple elegance.  I love it.  What more can I say?  Great product from Amazon once again!

AmazonBasics Leather Case with Swivel Clip for BlackBerry Curve (Black) is a great all-around case for the Blackberry Curve.  The case is light-weight, yet sturdy.  The top flap has a strong magnetic closure that keeps your Blackberry Curve securely in the case when not in use, but is easy to flip open and release when you need to use your phone.  The large clip on the back of the case was fairly sturdy, but made of plastic, and attaches well when clipped onto clothing.  The clip has a firm grip, but it is also easy to release when you need to remove it.  The leather is supple and soft and the stitching on the case is well-done and strong.AmazonBasics Leather Case with Swivel Clip for BlackBerry Curve (Black) is a good product and a great case for everyday use.

Want an upscale looking genuine leather, lambskin no less, Blackberry Curve holder?  There are quite a few to choose from and, in the extreme, some sport designer names and prices that near 3 digits.  If you want the same upscale look and quality at a ridiculous price under $10 then I am pretty sure this is about your only choice.  And what a good choice it is.  This thing just reeks of quality and its only sin is it is a bit delicate due to being made of lambskin which can be marred in appearance due to abrasion.  Lambskin is luxurious, however, and feels so rich and supple...Lambskin is also a strong leather as it has good elasticity and tensile strength for the same size and weight vs. cowhide.  In other words cowhide as light and thin as lambskin tends to have less tensile strength and splits sooner (I am a shoe retailer and a third generation shoe repairer so I am around leather on a daily basis).  So, this Blackberry Curve holder is excellent and the clip is very versatile as it rotates in no less than 6 locked positions, it is a screaming bargain...I don't know how they do quality like this at this price???  Oh well, the buyer wins so just get it.
summary: At The Price Point I Don't Know How The Quality Is So Good!

reviewText: This item is exactly what you'd expect from looking at the picture - nice quality leather, good solid construction, and a belt clip that will take plenty of abuse.The magnetic clasp may not be as strong as the blackberry equivalent, but for dress wear it would probably not present a problem.  For aggressive outdoor types, this may not quite meet the need.In spite of the promise of eco-friendly packaging (which the item itself was packed in - fit for mailing as-is) it arrived in a 36x6x9 carton!  Large enough to ship a whole case of these things.  No idea why - there are no moving parts that would suffer damage from shipment.But all in all a nice case!

This is a very nice case. The leather looks and feels good, handsome enough for a man but will also look great next to a woman's purse. The most amazing thing thing I found is the belt clip: it actually clicks into seven different positions - 180 degress. You could clip it on a belt, backup strap, purse, just about anything yet still keep it upright.This is designed for a Blackberry Curve so I won't deduct points that my LG enV Touch is slightly too big for this. While the phone fits the magnetic clip will not close. My phone is slightly too tall.Being a computer guy and told never to have your electronics near a magnet I am surprised that is what clasps this case closed. But maybe that isn't a problem or concern for phones or the memory card inside.For the price, leather and especially the rotating clip this is a great case.

I was initially delighted when this case arrived! The leather is of excellent quality and is butter-soft. The stitching is perfect and gives it a stylish appearance. It has a magnetic closure which works smoothly. The design is well-thought out, with the side gussets low on either side to allow for easy holstering and retrieval of your phone. The interior is lined with a soft, napped fabric to avoid scratches to the phone. The belt clip is sturdy, neatly attached and swivels smoothly.This case would be perfect except for one key feature that was left off - a magnetic, proximity sensor which automatically turns the back light off and locks the touch screen when holstering and back on when retrieving your phone! This is an extremely important feature to most Blackberry users as it conserves battery life and eliminates "butt dialing". I am confused at why Amazon took the time to design such a nice case, specifically cut for a Blackberry Curve, and failed to add this. Would have been 5 stars had it not been for this.
summary: Nice case, but lacks essential feature

reviewText: I like this case.  The lambskin leather has a good feel and the case is attractive.  The clip swivels six ways and seems sturdy.  A magnetic clasp holds the top in place, and grey top stitching is a nice contrast on the black leather.The clip attaches to your belt and seems fairly secure.  While the case is a bit roomier than the OEM case, I did not feel my phone would slip out.A good product and a great price.

This is an absolutely wonderful case.  I can use it for my phone or my Sony TX-7.  It has a magnetic clasp, looks good, and the leather is very soft.  The clip on the back is very sturdy and strong.  You can also rotate the clip so it's easy to wear upright or to the side.  The price is excellent and even though it's quite cheap, it doesn't feel or look cheap.  It really does the job well in a stylish manner.  Excellent value!  I would definitely recommend!
summary: Excellent Soft Leather Case for phone or camera

reviewText: This is a budget priced product. It is well made and offers great value. It has all the necessary clips for attachment. The materials are high quality. Highly recommended.

There's nothing really wrong with these protectors. They go on in the typically difficult way these things go on, and they protect about as well as the last protector I had. Their texture seems a little rubbery to me compared to other, smoother covers I've had in the past, but that might just be a taste thing -- it doesn't affect usability at all.All in all, if you need cheap screen protection, you could do worse than these.

This is my third iPhone. Each one has had a screen protector. In a couple cases, multiple. I've applied screen protectors to iPhones and similar devices dozens of times. There are two factors that I find make a huge difference in the product: (1) The ease of aligning the film; and, (2) how difficult it is to apply without creating air bubbles.(1) Whether or not you are skilled at aligning is more of a personal issue. However, the relative easy (or difficultly) of film removal after a failed alignment attempt is critical. Does the film still remain sticky if you lift it off? Are there creases in the plastic? These are two major concerns when you make an initial attempt to apply the film and fail. You don't want to be forced to dive into a second screen protector. I made to alignment attempts with this product and both lifted up easily without leaving creases in the film and the product was still tacky enough to make a third--successful--attempt.(2) This film is highly resistent to air bubbles! In my last attempt I aligned the film perfectly, but had a few air bubbles. The Amazon-provided, plastic squeegee pressed them out quickly and easily. I was impressed. This is definitely the most sturdy and effective squeegee I've used.All in all, very satisfied. Five screen protectors for this price is a great deal. The packaging is simple, efficient, and reusable.

These work great for the iPhone. Don't try to buy them for another phone and cut them to fit, it just doesn't work. They can get scratches, but having 5 in a pack makes it easy to swap them out. Overall, a nice product.

While this is a product that is very useful and helpful it could still be a little better.The clarity of the screen does go down more than when I have used other similar products out there for the very same thing. I've been a little disappointed with the results but not when compared to the price of these screen protectors.They do the job and the clarity isn't all that bad, it's just not as good as it could be.It's nice that amazon is starting to release more products under their name and have them at affordable/reasonable prices in general. I have been wondering when they would start doing this.Also related to this package, the card that comes with the kit is nice. normally I have to end up using my credit cards edges to smooth the screen out which for some reason makes marks all over the film. The card that came with is a nice bonus to make it all the easier to implement the film to the screen.All in all it's a good value product.
summary: good little screen protector, could be better though

reviewText: If you own an iPhone and need a screen protector, well you're in luck. These are pre-cut to fit the iPhone so it's pretty easy to use. Don't have an iPhone? Don't buy it. :)
summary: Screen protectors pre-cut for the iPhone

reviewText: THE BAD:  APPLICATIONI have now applied three of these--two on one phone and one on another, and my conclusion is that the Amazon Basics iPhone screen protectors suffer from the same issue that every other screen protector does:  It is essentially impossible to get them on without any bubbles.  Even with the most delicate caution, you will end up with at least one.  If you are lucky, most will come out later, but after three tries, I'm skeptical that anyone could do it reliably.I think that this could be fixed, however--the protectors come with a small "squeegie" intended to be used to push out bubbles.  However, the squeegie is not as wide as the face of the phone (it is about 70% as wide), so when you use it, you are applying pressure unevenly across the phone and are going to end up with a few bubbles.  Also, you want to make sure you apply the protector somewhere very clean (e.g., outside or anywhere a three year old child has been) as the smallest crumb or speck of dust will ensure a bubble, along with the trapped item visible under it.THE GOOD:  POST-APPLICATIONOnce applied, the protector does do a VERY good job of keeping the phone cleaner (seems to resist the inevitable finger marks my protector-less phone had) and I actually feel as if I have better tactile control than I did without it (which is great, because I worried that I would lose some of the fine touch for smaller work).OVERALL:  Good product, not greatIf you can live with a small bubble or two, you will be happy with this product.

I previously had a different brand of screen protector on my phone, but eventually removed it.  Although it applied cleanly at first, overtime I noticed it became pretty gross as it collected makeup resdue and dust around the edges of the protector (i.e. where the button is and along the perimeter of the phone).However, after the screen of my phone cracked I was willing to give screen protectors another try to hopefully protect my screen and give it a smoother surface to touch.Compared to the first product I tried, these were much easier to apply.  It seems like they have really designed this with the intent of making it easy so you don't get bubbles the first time.  That said, when you get 5 it's more reassuring that you have more if you screw up.That said, these still suffer from the same problems as screen protectors overall.  If you're using your phone a lot they can pick up particles along the edges of the sticker.  Because of that I've just come to expect I will have to change the stickers out once a month.
summary: Not convinced that screen protectors are the great way to go

reviewText: This is probably the third or fourth iPhone screen protector I've used, and I found it to be just as easy to install as any of the others.  Make sure the screen is wiped down REALLY well before you try to apply it.  These screen protectors come with a cloth for that.  There can't be ANY dust on the screen, otherwise you will definitely get a bubble.  The screen protector has 2 pieces of film covering the 2 sides, so you just peel off the first one, line it up with the edge of your iPhone screen, and start applying it slowly from one side of the phone to the other.  The screen protector is cut to EXACTLY the dimensions of the iPhone screen, so there is no room for error when you are lining it up.  Applied carefully enough, there is actually no need for the little mini-squeegee tool that it comes with.The screen protector is made really well, and I have no complaints about the quality.  It covers the entire glass face of the iPhone, rather than just a rectangle over the display part as some screen protectors do.  It is very durable, doesn't seem to scratch too easily, and it doesn't affect the sensitivity of the touch-screen.  I would definitely recommend these for any iPhone owner.

I'm surprised at how thin these things are.  I'm also surprised at how easy it was for me to apply this product to my phone, as I'm not the world's most coordinated person.  I was able to install this on the first try, and didn't have to go through the whole pack trying to get this applied without lots of annoying bubbles.The cleaning cloth and applicator card made a world of difference to me.  I like having everything I need to get something done included with a product.

These screen protectors work pretty well for me and will fit the iPhone 3G and 3GS. If you look at them at an angle, there is a little bit of a "rainbow" effect... the way it's refracting light. I doubt most people would even notice it.  Like all screen protectors, these are a bit hard to put on without getting bubbles and dust under the screen. I liked that there were two tabs on these that make them a bit easier to properly line up and stick onto the iPhone Screen. The included wipes and squeegee helps too.  I found that these are comparable to the Case-mate brand screen protectors I usually buy... but these are a better value.  The frustration-free packaging is a plus too.Conclusion:These iPhone screen protectors are of high quality and are at a reasonable price. I wouldn't hesitate to buy more of these. When they're on the phone, you can't tell there's even a screen protector on it. They're a bit challenging to put on... but all of the screen protectors out there are like that. I added a tip section to help you with the process if you've never done it before.  It will hopefully help you minimize messing up on placing them on your iPhone.Tip:  To help line up the screen protectors perfectly and stick them on without bubbles, here's a method I'd like to share... because it's quite frustrating to do it wrong and waste screen protectors in the process. So here's the way I like to do these:  To line up the screen protectors properly, lay it flat onto the iphone screen (with the sticker tabs still in place).  Once you have it lined up along the edges perfect, tape the bottom of it (with scotch tape) to bottom of the phone. This helps keep it lined up. If you do this properly, you should have a "hinge" created by the tape. Now, completely remove the bottom mask ( So that the sticky side is now completely exposed)... but keep the top tab/mask intact. Now while holding the top sticker tab, you can slowly squeegee the  screen protector onto the iphone screen (bottom side of phone first... working your way up to the top of the iphone)
summary: Quality Comparable to major Brand screen protectors

reviewText: You can never have too many iPhone protector films. I like having options to change mine periodically and this one, like all others, is a bit challenging to apply - you have to be patient and line it up properly over your iPhone - and then take out all the air bubbles - but otherwise i am enjoying it and clarity is very good. Thank you!
summary: A bit hard to put on but still very good

reviewText: I've used several iPhone screen protectors on my iPhone 3G and my wife's iPhone 3G S, and this iteration is OK, not the best I've seen, just OK. I look for three quality's in a screen protector: ease of installation, scratch resistance and staying power. It's even somewhat contentious if the 3G S even needs a screen protector as Apple would prefer you use the oleophobic screen bare; something which I would not recommend. As an aside, I am currently carrying an iPhone 4, which I will use without a screen protector and rely on the Gorilla Glass to stave off scratches.Installation was typical for this category, the sheet is a bit stiffer than is typical which makes it impossible to crinkle when laying it down, but the squeegy card was not stiff enough, making it hard to press down enough to completely get bubbles out.As for scratch resistance, I'm disappointed in this protector. It's been only a week and already I'm seeing visible scuffs in the surface. This might be bad luck, but I tend to think it just isn't durable enough.As for staying power, that seems to be fine. Often with these products, it's too easy for an edge to come loose and accumulate an ugly layer of dust. No indication of that happening here.In summary, OK but I recommend theKrypton Screen Armor 2-Pack for iPhone 3G and 3GSinstead, I've had good results with it.

THe screen fit very well on my 3GS that if you don't look close, you wouldn't know it. It also cut down some of the glare. Apply it to the phone is a tedious task, I missed a couple of times and had to do it over. Guess it is geared toward the pros! But at the end, I did just fine.

It protects the screen, yes. But it seems to attract dust and dirt and must be cleaned often, and the material the protector is made of gets scratched really easily. I guesss thats why it comes in packs of 5

I have the iphone and ordered these protector films wanting to protect the phone from the hard use I put it through.  I have to say that these do work but for a few problems.  First, it is really hard to get all the air bubbles out without ruining the stick on the film.  Secondly, the clarity of the film after it was on the phone made it look like I was looking through a fish tank.  Not bad, but a little grainy.  Lastly, once a corner gets turned up even a little, it gets caught on everything and I have yet to find a way to cut the corner off without either scratching the phone or peeling the entire film off.

The screen protector works great.  It has a nice film that adheres to the Iphone very well.  Only a few complaints it is required to order more than one because most likely you will mess up the first or second since it is pretty hard to perfectly align it to the iphone on the first try.

It's possible I got a bad package of these screen protectors, but I went through all of them in one evening, because even through I used the provided cloth, and eventually another cloth meant for a camera lens, there were specks of dust (not visible by two different people on the iPhone) that almost seemed to be on the film from manufacturing. Of course, there was no way to fix that.bI did like that you got 5 films instead of the normal 1-3, and it came with a little hard piece of cardboard to smooth out bubbles, in addition to the cleaning cloth. There just seemed to be something wrong with these that they came preloaded with tiny flaws.Assuming one got a good package, they were easy to install, and fit my 3GS perfectly.
summary: Not a Single One Was Usable

reviewText: With this product, you get quantity, not quality.These screen protectors are thin and prone to scratching.  Mine got scratched from just wiping it with a soft cloth after applying it.Also, these have a 'rainbow' look to it when the iPhone's display is off.  When it's on, you don't notice it as much.One other thing to note is that these will not work with the 'slider' type cases such as the Incase Slider as the screen protector and the edge of the case overlap, causing it to bubble up.  This may be a design flaw of the slider cases but it's worth noting.

At less than $1 a screen protector, the price is good. You can pay a lot more for what essentially is a sheet of plastic. The AmazonBasics Screen Protector Film applies easily if you follow the instruction and are meticulous about lining it up correctly and squeegeeing out the air bubbles. It feels just like a naked screen, with the exception of around the button where you can feel the extra layer. There's no way around this.The pack comes with a squeegee and a small cleaning cloth. These protectors are not anti-glare. They are tacky (sticky, not a comment on fashion) on the screen side. Some people recommend only using cling screen protectors on 3GS phones because of fear about damaging the 3GS's oleophobic (smear resistant) screen. I've not found the 3GS screen to be very oleophobic to begin with, but you might want to research this issue yourself.Whether or not a screen protector is needed is a matter of debate. It probably depends on how you handle your phone. I've had mine for one year without a screen protector, and it looks new. If you keep your phone in a pocket or purse without a case where it could come in contact with keys or other items, a screen protector seems to make sense.The item came packed in a small, frustration-free 9 by 6 inch cardboard envelope (nice) shipped in a very large, 32 by 12 by 6-inch box (not nice). Maybe this was a Vine-thing. It could have been shipped just in the envelope.

If you have an iphone and don't use this screen protector your crazy.  Here's the thing, you MUST take your time to get these on the right way.  If you rush through the way I did, you will waste at least 2 of them....hey maybe that's why they sell it in a 5 pack.  If you take your time and apply it correctly, they are awesome...a must have.

First, let me say I'm a big fan of a number of AmazonBasic products, including the anti-glare iPhone 3G Screen Protectors - this is the first time I've had a bad experience with any of the brand's products.These protectors have a defect - the "2nd" tab doesn't remove, the adhesive has aged and will no longer peel off.  To remove, I tried several efforts: regular peeling off, soaking chemicals, microfiber cloth, and scratching(hey, I had a pack of 5 to try...) -- all of them produced the same result -- a scratched corner (or worse across the screen) and added several bubbles underneath as you tried to pull it off.what a disaster!  I've haven't checked into warranty remedies at this point - but really, at this price, you just toss.
summary: Defect!  Tabs don't come off - disaster

reviewText: I have so many friends who have iPhones that don't have screen protectors and they drop and get screen cracks or scratches. This is seriously a must have to protect your screen. It takes a try or too to not have bubbles, but once you get it its like there is no protector. What a great deal also under the Amazon basic line- Gotta love these, and please protect your screen ( and read the directions to apply )

It is a shame these are not yet available for iPhone 4 as Amazon has come through with an inexpensive and easy to use counter to the screen protectors put out by other companies.The protectors are much like any other, clear (non-mirrored), relatively simple to put on with the nicely provided squigee and good for protecting against minor scrapes and scratches.  What sets apart the Amazon brand is the price.  Currently less than two dollars a screen, this is less than half the cost of other screen protectors.Yes, it is a generic brand and not an official Apple product, but they work and they are cost effective.

I got both the these and the anti glare versions and I defintely prefer these due to the better picture it gives on the phone.  The anti-glare ones, while a bit helpful in reducing glare, also reduce the picture brightness and crispness that the Iphone produces.  It's not a flaw in the amazon design as other anti-glare protectors do the same thing.For these regular protectors, I found installtion no different from other brands I've used, although I did ruin one of them when I though I had removed the top film after applying it but it ended up taking the entire screen proctector off.  Not realizing that i procedded to place it down and got lint and dust on it which makes it unusable after that.  My second one went on without issue and i have been using that for a while now.  It is bubbling in the corners but I have that issue with all of the protectors I've used.  Most likely my fault on installtion so I can't blame Amazon.Overall, I will probably buy these protectors from now on thanks to easy of ordering from Amazon.  I just hope i don't run into the film removal problem again!

Let me just start by saying I have purchased similar products off ebay as well as the ZAGG brand of protectors and for the value - you can't beat the amazon basics. The application is certainly easier than the ZAGG, which requires you wet multiple surfaces and squeegee. However, since a squeegee is provided with tha Amazon product its certainly better than the eBay "specials". One thing I'd like to also point out is that the quality is better as well on these Amazon Basics vs the eBay "specials". Is the quality better than ZAGG? NO - but then you aren't spending $20 for this item.All in all a great value considering price and quantity5/5 stars
