reviewText: My first Incipio case was awesome, so I was excited to get my boyfriend a new Incipio case that was red. That turned to disappointment when it started ripping almost immediately.  The rubber got worn fast and the case was soon unusable.

As with all things, case designs have to make compromises. If you want ultimate protection, be prepared for a tank of a case. If you want sleek looks to match the iP4, be prepared for flimsy designs. Unfortunately you can't have it all (at least at a reasonable price-point). The Incipio Silicrylic is a good compromise in my opinion.The silicone inner linner is incredibly soft, providing adequate shock absoption while keeping the overall package thin. The polycarb outer layer provides an extra layer of impact resistance from blunt and hard objects. It probably won't save your phone from a 2+ meter drop, but occasional drops from waist or chest height should not be a problem. I'm sure the case won't come out pristine, but better the case than the phone.So far I have tried the following cases:* Apple Bumper- Looks great, but adds little protection.* Griffin Reveal Etch- Great look and feel, but the sides are not snug enough to the phone.* Speck Candyshell- Superb protection, but it bulks up the phone too much IMO and scratches WAY too easily. Incompatible with most connectors and docks.Pros:- Good compromise of thinness and protection- Superb compatability with pin connectors (works with basically anything)- Good compatability with 3rd party docks (thin enough to work with most)- Easy access/function with all phone controls- Good looks- Easy to install/remove- Perfect fitment/alignment- No "flash haze"- Easy in/out of pocketsCons:- Exposed silicone layer picks up lint occassionally, but thankfully it is easily removed- Polycarb layer has plasticky feel to it- Silicone material around the Home button can be a little annoying- Could use silicone inserts on the sides for better gripOverall, the Silicrylic case makes an excellent compromise between looks and protection while adding superb functionality.

I bought this case for my boyfriend's iPhone after buying the DualPro for my Moto X. I like the way the DualPro feels more,but this case also feels pretty awesome. It's very snug against the phone and looks amazing, the black really blends in well and looks to be a part of the phone itself. Offers pretty good protection, it's been dropped on hard wood floors quite a few times since the case was put on and no flaws on the phone.

I like this case. As long as your pretty careful with your phone, it successfully protects against light falls (with impact to the back) and against scratches to the back. That said, it certainly will not protect against much of an impact to the front. I originally used a much larger otter box, which did a really great job of protecting everything on the phone while it was brand new. After time passed and the phone lost value, I thought it appropriate to trade protection for greater ease of portability. I'd recommend this case for people who want something small and who only value their phone at a moderate level.Additional comments:- The soft nature of the case sometimes makes it difficult to remove from tight pockets.- Despite the small size, I still need to remove the case to place the phone in a charging stand.
summary: Protects against lite falls without adding excessive size

My friend adviced me of this cover.  I have always used another brand, and I can honestly say this brand is what I will be going with in the future.  Very good for price!

I ordered the purple case. (dark purple hard shell and soft light purple inter shell) What I got in the mail was a different case with different color combo. I called amazon and told them about it. They said they they would overnight me the right one. They sent the package the very next day and again was the wrong color combo. A different case with different colors. I called amazon for the second time. The lady said that there was a problem in the warehouse and that this item is no longer in stock. (yet it states on the website that its in stock) She said that they cant figure out how to get it off the site. They are giving me my money back for the case. I just would not order the purple one because I think that they should have stated this on the site.
Got it for my 9 year old daughter after I upgraded my iPhone and gave her my old 4S, she loves it, and she has dropped her phone like a hundred times, and nothing! no damage! Great case!
Nice protection for the phone but still a little bulky for the iPhone 4s, nice color and easy to find in purse or on counter.  Good quality product.

I bought the Incipio Silicrylic initially because the otterbox defender was not out at the time of release. I loved the colors and liked the protection it gave over the standard cases. I dropped my phone on a brick walkway leaving work and though there was a chunk missing from the corner of the case the phone was unharmed! I was delighted with the case at that point. The downfall came about a month into using the case, I noticed the coating began to come off the sides of the hard backing. I think there is a quality issue here as I never experienced this with otterbox cases.  The other issue is that the soft shell gets loose especially above the charging port. I think that if I dropped the phone and it were to fall straight down the rubber would push to the side and the bottom glass would be exposed to chipping. I like the slim feel and the look of this case however I think I would like something a bit more protective so I have gone ahead and ordered the Otterbox Defender from Amazon.
summary: Nice case with some quality issues

reviewText: I have not found a case that protects an iphone as well as this one without adding a lot of bulk. If you need waterproof then get a lifeproof. If you dont, then this is the case for you
summary: This is the best case if you dont need it to be waterproof

reviewText: I really recommend Incipio hard shell cases with silicone insert because it really keeps your phone protected.  This product is simple to get on and off and looks nice on your phone.  I am a person who frequently drops their phone so it is nice to have the corners covered because that is the first place you start to see dings.  These cases are nice because you can interchange the colors if you buy more than one, and I have a Verizon iPhone so their accessories are outrageously expensive so it is nice to purchase them at a more reasonable price on Amazon.

It protects well but I however would suggest a Speck or Otterbox case just because this 2 piece system they have going on is not only a hassle, but when you move the plastic off first, sometimes is digs into the rubbery part and rips it.
Incipio never fails me, I love it. It's a smooth design, my extension cord for my charger cord fits well in it. I have a pink one too. It's cheaper than Verizon charging an arm and a leg for it.

I went to the Verizon Store and other big box retailers and literally took every iPhone4(s) case out of the box and tested it on my new phone. The advantage to this dual case from Incipio is that it comes in a variety of different color combinations and you're able to get two contrasting colors (white/gray looks really good on a white iPhone). The inner silicone case goes on very easily, but provides minimal support and feels exactly like a balloon that hasn't been inflated. The case covers some of the buttons on the side, but it is still easy enough to press them.The outer case provides some much needed protection and it slides right on over the silicone inner layer. The sliding on wasn't as easy as I was anticipating and once in place you can see a few spots where the outer layer does not provide any protection (top/bottom). Once both layers are in place the phone has a nice sturdy feel without having too much bulk added.Overall this is a decent case, but there were better options out there from Belkin and Case Mate that only had one hard outer layer that felt sturdier and was easier to put on and take off. You could use just the outer layer of this case without the inner silicone, but I wouldn't recommend solely using the inner layer.
summary: Decent case, but the inner silicone layer is mediocre at best

reviewText: I've used this line of case since I bought my iPhone 4s. I love the fact that it covers your whole phone including the buttons with holes just big enough for the camera and speaker/microphone. The silicone sleeve comes around over the edge of the screen so it adds protection if you place the phone face down. I did drop my phone from about desk high onto my hardwood floor and the case broke in the corner but it protected my phone perfectly. I've gone through two cases this way but replacing them is a lot cheaper than replacing the phone.

I purchased this as a gift to a family member, and she loves it! The plastic backing to the case gives durability, while the silicone jacket gives the case a soft touch, and protects the phone well. There is room for all ports to be accessed- charging, speakers, volume, mute, headphones and the camera. I would recommend this to anyone looking for a sturdy iPhone 4 or 4S case!

We have stuck with Incipio through (2) iPod touches and another iPhone and like the quality and feel of their products.  This is no exception.  The cutouts are precisely placed and the combination of silicone and the hard shell provides good protection.  Will keep buying their products in the future.
summary: Fourth incipio purchase and did not disappoint

reviewText: It was a nice case, protected well for a pretty minimal size, but within 4-6 months, the silicone edges had ripped/split at several corner areas.  Replaced it with this: http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B005T0DTM2/ref=cm_cr_ryp_prd_ttl_sol_52 and have been much happier.
summary: The silicone started to rip sooner than expected

reviewText: I was looking for a case that would be protective and not as bulky as an otterbox.  This worked fine for me

I've had this case since the first week of November 2011.  I bought it for a new iPhone 4S.  I must say, this is one of the best cases I've ever owned for a phone.  I've bought everything from the cheapest cases to the most expensive for past phones.  One of the most expensive cases I've ever owned was a Droid case that started out okay but literally fell apart at the seams after a few months.  This case is holding up very well.  It's a silicone case, so if you're particularly rough or harsh on your phone, expect fast wear and tear.  I use my iPhone regularly but I'm careful with it and never beat it up or throw it around as I've seen a lot of others do.  Not only do my phones look the same at the end of my contract as they did the day I bought them, but cases last pretty good as well.  So for that expensive case to fail, it really must have been rubbish.  This affordable case on the other hand, is not rubbish and fits the phone like a glove.  It offers a stylish non-slip gripping surface, and all buttoins, cameras, and openings have perfect cut-outs.  Nothing is obstructed, not even partially.  My 4S fits perfect.  The only intentionally covered buttons are the volume buttons and power button.  The thickness and flexibility of the case is just right, allowing me to easily push the buttons whenever needed, even without looking.  The bottom of the scase is cut so perfectly, it allows my iphone to fit on my speaker dock without removing the case.  Now that is a major plus.  I mainly carry the phone in my pocket and occassionally some lint will intrude, but it's nothing a can of spray air and a quick wipe with a cloth can't fix.  If anything gets really bad or a lot of debris finds its way into the case, the case is easily removable for cleaning or whatever the need may be.  I am very happy with this case and very satisfied with my purchase.  This has become my new iPhone case of choice.  And the price only makes it better.
summary: After two months it's still great

reviewText: I bought this based on price and some reviews. It is a great product for screen and phone cover, but I don't think it will protect your phone when dropping on concrete.
summary: Great product and the price is cheap

reviewText: Bought it for my wifes phone and so far so good no damages. Lots of little spills from little hands and no problems.

This case is protective but I can still put it into my pocket or purse without stretching the case out which is awesome! The case stays clean, is super soft and it comes in cute colors! I got the grey and pink and I love it! Also this case is super easy to put on your phone and thankfully doesn't have those crappy little plastic pieces clipping the case to the phone that break the first time you take the case off!
summary: Best phone case I've had for my iPhone 4 yet!

reviewText: great protection with minimal bulk. gives great protection with out bulk like an otterbox. and comes with a screen protector.i have these cases on 4 different types of phones. incipo does wattenty these cases and their customer service is easy the one case i broke (razr maxx case) taking it off to clean (my fault) they replaced free

I purchased a similar case for my iPhone 5 and liked it, so I purchased this iPhone case for my fiancee.  She loves the color and the feel of the silicone core.  It looks great.  The plastic is a bit difficult to get on at first, but once it's on, it stays on.

I really liked the colors on this case but the rubber/silicone part of the case is not tight on the phone.  So when you place the top hard part of the case it moves the whole thing off having to often adjust to fit properly but it doesn't stay in the right place.  It almost looks like it doesn't fit right on the phone.  I only had it for a week and took it off.

This is an excellent case.  This is the second one I've had for my wife's phone.  The first one protected the phone when it fell 20 feet from the grandstands at a local race track onto asphalt.  A corner of the case broke off but the phone was fine.  I immediately ordered another one.
I love Silicrylic's hard shell cases with the silicone.  It's perfect protection for my iPhone.  I have two of these cases and love the two offsetting colors.

I got this for my iphone 4 (verizon) and it works great! I loved the colors, and the case is not bulky at all! I wanted something durable, but I didn't want to pay for an otterbox or have a bulky case like that. I've already dropped my phone on rough asphalt and it went rolling. No scratches or problems! My only complaint is that the grey back can get a little dirty from it being light enough to show dirt. But that's nothing a little soap and water can't fix!

I love this case!  First of all, it is good looking.  The pink on grey is very pretty.  It's kind of a "hot pink".  Not really a magenta or pepto-pink.  You start with the stick-on protector.  The one it comes with is the glossy as opposed to the matte.  I prefer the matte, but I'm finding things I like about the glossy.  For one thing, it went on a lot easier than a matte and I didn't have as much trouble getting the bubbles out.  Then you slip on the silicone sleeve, which is a cinch to put on, and then that is covered by the hard plastic, which feels kind of soft and velvety to the touch...not slick and shiny.  It fits on my iPhone 4 perfectly.(I don't know about the 4S)  And that's it.  It's not bulky, yet I feel like my phone is fairly safe in this case if I happen to drop it.  It's got looks AND functionality!

great color fits good and does what it needs to do! Plus im a purple fanatic so the color was wonderful! Protects well i will say compared to the otterbox commuter case the rubber is a little thinner on this case but it still protects and does its job.

It was actually better than expected. It was a gift and the recipient was very pleased.  No offense to Incipio, this is an excellent case. This is the reason I don't write reviews. I hate being told how much or little I should say. I will not be writing anymore reviews!!!

i have tried so many other cases that i got tired of looking and had my berkin for a long time till now!! my friend had showed me this and i went crazy looking around for it but in the stores they were to pricey and i didnot want to take a chance and maybe it will be a wack case again like my other ones. i thought about amazon like i always do and i fell in love with this color. fits great and looks great. the best case i can really tell everyone about and they wont be upset. this is a must get case and im ready to collect thhem all in every color!!!!!!!!!!!! thanks amazon!!!!!

The case was a Christmas gift for my neice and she was very surprised and happy. I was very satisfied w/my purchase and the case was exactly what I wanted. I will definitely be back. I love Amazon its the best!

this case was sleek and looked nice as well.  I liked how the inner red part is a silicone shell which protects it first than the black outer shell is plastic.  it basically has two layers of protection and looks good as well

Best case I've found for the iPhone 4s. I like the two tone color, the hard shell and silicrylic material are both durable.The case isn't bulky and provides adequate protection including the edge of the screen/bezel. Overall, very good case all around.
not an otterbox.  no real protection. scratches easy as very shinny.  will do in a pinch if you have nothing else.
Wow, what's great case. If you want a great minimalist case, this is it!I usually HATE iPhone cases, and go naked, but this is such a great fit.

Thin, transparent, light. But most of all, protects your phone. I dropped my phone out of the car twice, when I got out yesterday. not a scratch.

reviewText: It's described as a hard case but it feels and looks like plastic.  One thing I like is it does not add any bulk to my phone, which is also a bad thing because it makes me feel like the phone will slip.  I wouldn't recommend this case.

This case fits my verizon iphone 4S nicely, but it provides little protection for the screen.  I do have a screen protector, but I wish this case had a bit of a lip.  Other than that, it slides in and out of my pocket well, and looks nice.  Very thin!

Not much in surprises here. It's a hard plastic case that fits well. The finish on this one is glossy and the color is a pearl white. The touch is smooth to the point it can be a bit slippery. So far I'm happy with the way it goes with my white iPhone 4s.I was looking for something very minimalist in approach.  It doesn't offer the most protection but for what it is it's okay.

I keep my phone on my back pocket at work...and I only wear jeans.  The case is already peeling on the edges.  Also, my iPhone4 seems to ride a millimeter or two above the case.The only plus is that I have access to all the buttons and ports.

Not sure what others were writing about when they said that the case began to peel.  I've had mine for a few weeks now and it works and looks great!  I've bought several products from Incipio in the past and have never been disappointed.

This case worked like a usual case. But on the rare occasion I had to take it off, it kept chipping the corner of my phone. Then, the corner of the case broke off and it was rendered useless anymore. Won't be buying a snap on case anymore.

I just keep going back to this case because its so think, doesn't add too much bulk, feels great (grippy), and looks good on the phone.  However, the previous two breaks in the same place:  the top most corner where the ringer slider is.

reviewText: I wanted a case for my iPhone 4 that would cover the antennas,  the back of the phone, but leave unrestricted access to the excellent tactile controls on the side and top.  This works perfectly and is well made from quality materials.
summary: Nice if you want quality and light weight

reviewText: Bought this case thinking it was metal.  That was my fault, I didn't read the description well enough.  Regardless, it is pretty low quality and does not provide much protection for the phone.  There are plenty of other, better cases that are similarly priced.

I've had my case for about 6 months now and use it everyday. Here's just my short pro/con list of my usage so far:PRO:- White version blends nicely with the color of the phone- Good quality, I've dropped my phone on the backside a couple of times and no damage to phone or case- Not bulky at all, slides in and out of my pocket easilyCONS:- Paint is start to chip from the case. Very nice hard cover for the iPhone. Not as thick or substantial as I thought it would be, but it is a nice covering for the phone for now.

I like this case a lot and it looks nice on the phone without adding any size to the iphone 4s.  Only downside is that I have to take it off in order to use my iPhone in my Bose speaker dock.  Apart from that, the case is awesome.

The clear case is great if you want to protect your phone from scratches without having a bulky, ugly covering. My only complaint is that it doesn't snap on perfectly. reviewerName: D. Deutsch "Chance favors the prepared mind."
reviewText: I bought this case at Staples on a whim after my Trent Power Case cracked. I liked the extended use that the Trent provided, but the size and weight of the phone and battery was annoying after awhile.The Incipio Feather case is a move in the opposite direction from my previous choice. This case is as minimalist as you can probably get. It is a touch over 1 millimeter thick and leaves the top and bottom of the case exposed while covering the corners. The camera and buttons are extremely accessible.The face of the phone is completely exposed with the lip of the case anchored to the antenna. This design provides a nice unobstructed view of the screen, but also may allow the screen to scratch more frequently. A screen protector will mitigate this problem but may become snagged and peel away from the phone.The case is easy to put on and pull off and seems to stay on well. It provides decent grip and feels comfortable to hold. I like this case for its minimalist qualities and preliminary wear suggests that it adequately protects the phone.

Well, I've had this case since Friday (4 days ago) and its already started getting discolored and dirty, not to mention its starting to chip as well. I'm sending this case back instantly. Definitely going to look for another company.I recommend no one purchase this case.

I bought this case for my iphone 4 for its sleek low profile look. I wanted a case that I could still put my phone in my pocket and be able to take it out easily. This case fulfills that completely. I had this case for about 4 months until a crack started to happen in the corner and my phone didn't stay in the case very well. 3 out of 5 stars because I liked the case but the build is poor. I wouldn't want to drop my phone with this case on it even.

Bought this for my sister and it fell apart within about a couple months... She liked the idea of the case but it is meant for pretty light-duty use.  Does do a good job of protecting the back of the phone
This is for my husband.  Its very sharp looking.  He doesn't like a rubber phone case and this one is smooth and slips into his pocket easily.

A naked iPhone 4 has too much exposed fragile glass, thus prone to scratches and breakage.  I also find the sharp edges uncomfortable on my hands when compared to the rounded edges of the previous iPhones.My ideal case is one that does not add bulk, protects all surfaces, is comfortable to hold, allows for access to all bulky chargers and docks, and fits loosely inside my belt case.  After physically comparing 7 other cases and 3 bumpers, and researching tens of other cases, I have not yet found my ideal case, but I returned this case and kept theSonix Snap Slim Case for iPhone 4 with 2 Screen Protectors (Black).This case adds little bulk to the iPhone 4 (good).  It protects the back and the camera lens (good).  My bulky chargers and docks connect to the 30 pin connector without needing to remove the iPhone 4 from the case (good), which is a problem with many other cases and the Apple Bumper.  It is more comfortable to hold than a naked iPhone 4 (good).  My belt case can accommodate the iPhone 4 inside of this case without much fuzz (good).  However, this case lost 2 stars due to when laid upside down on a flat surface, the front of the phone is completely exposed (see picture above).  I returned this case and kept theSonix Snap Slim Case for iPhone 4 with 2 Screen Protectors (Black).

This case is awesome. I used it for the better part of a year before I replaced it with an Opena case <-- get one. It now rests on my friends phone and has only just now started showing some wear and tear ( about 2 years later )
wasn't anything special. within 2 weeks it started chipping and and peeling on the corners. i don't use it any more

This case is really really good. I wanted to get an ultra slim case because I was going to use it with a leather wallet type case, and it fits with no problem. It does not protect the screen if phone falls upside down but I knew of this before getting it. The best thin hard case I could find and it came with a screen protector and cleaning cloth.

It is an item that I recommended people buying who want a small case with little to no protection. This was definitely the site to make the purchase. It looks really nice, just not what a cover is for.

I hate cases, but realize a $600+ phone needs some protection even if you are very careful like I am.  This case offers some protection but you hardly know it's there.  Plus, it still allows you to see most of the phone which is a good thing.  This case plus a screen protector is all most people need IF YOU ARE CAREFUL.  If you are hard on your stuff go with something else.This case is really good looking, fits well and adds absolutely no bulk to the phone.  In fact, it makes the iphone a lot easier to hold.  Don't understand the other reviews complaining about a lack of protection when the name of the case is "Feather".Can't comment on the long term durability but I did have a problem with my Feather for the 3GS and Incipio was very responsive and sent a replacement.UPDATE:  I have had 2 cases crack around the volume buttons with moderate use.  Although I do like the case I can't recommend it because of durability.

reviewText: I got the orange soda color and it looks fantastic on my white iPhone; I get compliments every time I use it. However, I only pull it out when I'm feeling lucky because it does next to nothing to protect the phone.

I just got a 4S (serious upgrade for me, as I have been using the 3G since 2008) and bought this case prior to the delivery of my phone. Amazon doesn't really make it clear which cases are the matte ones and which ones are just plastic.. I got the grey case which unfortunately is just plastic so it doesn't feel like it's worth the money I paid, whereas I think the matte covering would have made a bigger difference.It covers the phone okay, but leaves the top and bottom exposed. It also doesn't go up the sides of the phone all the way, coming up just short of the glass so the white glass on the sides are still exposed. Also, it's extremely difficult to remove -- I was scared I would either snap the case or scratch the phone. The only upsides to this case are that it's thin and light, and that I can put the phone down without worrying I'll scratch the camera lens.I'm still using it for the time being because I haven't found a case that's as light as this one (ie another case that doesn't add considerable bulk to the phone). It's fine for what it is, but I'm sure there are better cases out there.
My iPhone cases have usually lasted for the life of the phone (~2 years), but this Incipio model broke after four months. Bottom edges can be sharp, not very rounded edges.
summary: Bottom corner piece broke after four months

reviewText: This is for the Incipio IPH-660 Iridescent Gunmetal case. This was just what I expected when I ordered it. I am happy with the quality. Also, 2 screen protectors were included for free! Good quality screen protectors.

this case is a poor excuse for protection for the phone!  it doesn't even come up the sides far enough to leave a lip sticking out the front of the phone to protect the screen.  if you dropped it on the screen this case would do nothing for you, it covers the back and only part of the sides....already returned it - you can do better!
I am very pleased with this iphone case.  Pretty color too!  It really protects my phone.  It was easy to install and the price was certainly right!

I love this case.  It doesn't interfere with any screen protector and hasn't had any wearing issues as with other cases.  This product also came with a couple screen protectors that have been better than any other protector I've found.

Good quality, maintains the slim profile of the iPhone while still offering some protection. Could never understand the people who put those Otter Box cases on a an iPhone and triple the girth.  Very easy to take on and off as well.

The Incipio iPhone case in Paparazzi Purple is a really terrific minimalist case. Snaps onto the phone with a quality fit, and has a lovely soft rubberized feel. reviewText: Great Case if you want a thinner light case for your iphone. This works well for me, but may not be for everyone. If you want great protection, buy an otter box.

My fiancee and I bought the iPhone 4 on pre-order day and ended up getting ours a day or two before it was released in stores. The downside? No cases were available in town. Cute case.  Nothing too special.  Good price.  As expected and quick delivery.  Thanks for a good product!!  Would recommend to anyone looking for a cute cheap case.
Slim as described, which was exactly what I was looking for. Has received a few scratches on the back. This is not your heavy duty protector but it works great for me.

Pretty much worthless sums things up nicely. To be "fair" it fits well and as a fashion item it is probably ok. As far as the quality goes it is pretty much destroyed after a month in my wifes purse, its dull with scratches and cracked. As far as protection goes it gets a zero. Other than wrapping the phone it would provide zero drop protection. As I said completely worthless, save your money and get something, anything, other than this.

I saw a friend with a similar case, she got hers at a Big Box store that causes me major anxiety when I even think of shopping there. Kindly, she sent me the link for this case, and I love it. It's matte finished so you don't see finger prints, it's light weight, and the bottom is open so it doesn't interfere with charging, the volume control, and on/off buttons are exposed for easier access. I had a bumper that I purchased from the Apple store and after discovering this case, I feel silly for spending $30.00 for that lame bumper.
summary: Thank you for saving me 15 bucks!

reviewText: I like this case because it is very lightweight and doesn't add much bulk to your phone.  The case protects my phone from scratches.

Very quick delivery of product.  Love the way it fits and contributes very little bulk to the phone.(also has a quality appearance) Great product when compared with some of the other cases I have owned.

Product arrived in good condition and it was easy to put it on.  However, the material of the cover is easy to break, especially on the edge.  Mine broke after 6 month usage, would expect to last a little longer.
My teenage daughter had this on her phone.  Not nearly enough protection for a teenager and the finish peeled in a few months.  There are better choices out there.  Try a TPC case.

I decided to give this case a try due to the recommendations I've received from my friends and fellow forum goers. The case itself looks great (aside from the giant Incipio logo which is a bit of a turnoff). I have owned incipio products before and found that their items are usually reliable.But the feather is just not up to par. First, the edges are sharp like knives. There's absolutely no reason this should be the case. It offers no utility and just shows that the manufacturer were lazy with this aspect. Secondly, the case itself scratches easily and cracks easily. Although, this is a common complaint of cases of this nature so I don't think it's really fair to ding Incipio for this.The screen shields included are also of easily scratch quality. It's all forgiveable, the reason I docked three stars is purely because of the sharp edges. there is just no excuse for it.

There is always a Beware when something is not quite up to snuff.  This appeared to be a very nice product, but it cracked on one of the corners after just 6 weeks, of course after the 30 day return policy.  I have the Incipio feather for a Nokia 928, constructed of Rigid Plextonium and it has been fantastic.  I thought when i ordered this it was of the same type of material and would serve the same purpose, it's not and and it has broken.  I wish the Incipio made this shell case out of the same material, then it would get a 5 star like i gave it's predecessor.  "DO NOT BUY THIS PRODUCT".

I really like the slim look of this case, and I love the color.  It's kind of a matte dark purple.  I like that my phone isn't bulky at all with this case, although, I haven't dropped it with this case yet, so I can't really say how well it protects.  My other incipios have all been wonderful through many drops (yes, I'm a klutz!) so I'm hoping this one will hold up just as well.  It looks like good corner protection, and that seems to be the key with the iphones.
Light wait , silky feel in hand,easy grip. Worth buying this case. Better than my previous silicon case. I drooped my phone on frozen lake. No impact on phone.
Title sums it up with and it really doesn't wear very well either.  Inciprio will warranty it but you have to spend postage to send it back which is really not worth it given the price.

Overall the Incipio Ultralight cases are pretty good. However there is a pretty glaring flaw with these cases. I like them because they protect the phone while being minimally intrusive. However because they're a slim fit case the area around the upper left corner of the phone near the volume control is very weak. Every one of these cases I've had broke in the same spot. This aside the cases are very sleek, slim and work great with the phone. The chrome one is very shiny which is hard to tell from the product pictures. Although the pictures look more like a dull or brushed chrome it's certainly a mirror finish. These cases are great because of the slim fit but you sacrifice some durability especially near the volume controls.*** UPDATE ****This case has since broken in the aforementioned place. My wife pulled it out of her purse, it got snagged on something and then SNAP. So keep in mind this design weakness when purchasing. They're great looking cases but ours lasted less than 2 months.

I bought this based on positive reviews, but it didn't work out for me. While it is a minimal case, the plastic material feels very cheap and flimsy. Given how much it costs, I was disappointed. Also, it provides pretty much little if any actual protection for the iPhone should it be dropped. I can't recommend this.
this case was a lot more flimsy than what I thought it would be I had the small page right above the volume buttons break shortly after installing it on my phone.

No, it doesn't offer the protection of an otterbox. It also doesn't offer the BULK associated with those cases! I have a warranty on my phone...if I break it, I pay $50 and get it fixed. I wanted a THIN case that doesn't add BULK to my phone, but protects against scratches, and that is exactly what it does! I have the white, which is a nice pearl-white finish. The only problem I see is that the white of the case is WAY more white than the phone. It makes my phone look a little yellow-ish.
summary: GREAT if you're looking for an ULTRA thin!

reviewText: The Incipio Feather series is my personal Gold Standard for slim cases for my devices.  I own them for my iPads, iPhones, Android phones, etc.  This Feather is another in a long line of great products.  The soft touch exterior gives a good grip while the thinness of the case doesn't add bulk to the beautiful iPhone.  Well made of durable plastic I've never had a problem with any Incipio case.  The green of this case is almost a Kelly green; perfect for St. Patty's Day! :)  All button and ports are easily accessible which is, of course, a must for any case.  Buy this case with no reservations.  It's fantastic.
summary: My Gold Standard for Slim Cases

reviewText: I bought this case to replace the SAME one that I cracked.  You might think that replacing it with the same case is odd-- since the first one was cracked.I drop my phone a lot.  Too much.  It's actually a bit embarrassing.  I abused the first case so much yet never had damage to my phone.  I'm sure I've also been lucky but it just made sense to stick with something I know works for me.  I got the same cover for my son's phone.
This was a great case.  Until I cracked it somehow.  I would buy another, but I hate to spend $15 on a case that might break again in 2 months.  I'm going to go with something a little bit sturdier.

I didn't want to cover up the beauty that is the iPhone's design so this was the best option. Radio Shack has these for about the same price so I'll go there now to avoid waiting around. Although it added almost no bulk, it doesn't offer a ton of protection either. This is mainly for people who are careful with their phones, want it to stay looking good, and hate bulk.Note, this does affect the use of docks and holders. Make sure the dock or holster is adjustable before assuming this will fit.

After all the good reviews i read about this case, the one problem i did not expect was the actual fitting of the case. I got it for my brothers iPhone and it doesn't even fit! One of it's sides is slightly bent backwards and it prevents the case from snapping on. If i could, i would give this product ZERO stars

I have a ballistic case and was looking for a case that was smaller is size but still had the same grip as the ballistic. The Incipio Case did not have the grippy touch to it, in fact was a little slippery from what I am use to with the ballistic. The Incipio is cool for its size and dosent have the big bulkyness like the outter box or the ballistic. It also fits comfortlly in your pocket! I went back to my ballsitic.. If any one wants my Incipio, email me at frakesfab@sbcglobal.netThanks!

This case is perfect. I have had it for a little over a week and I dropped my iphone for the second time ever today. Outside on the cement road with this case on it and not a single scratch; still in perfect shape. By far, this is the best case I have ever bought: every day ease of use wise, and protection wise! it protects perfectly and is very durable yet isn't too hard plastic or gummy. The material and feeling of the case is slippery enough to slide in and out of your pocket but not out of your hands! Buttons are all so easy to press. All ports easily accessible and has a great lip on the front of the case which saved my phones screen from shattering today when it landed face down! No hue when taking pictures with flash and it fits snuggly on the phone. A perfect fit. Best case out there, I am definitely buying again!

Ive been looking for a case for my white verizon 4s for a while now. one that looks cool, FITS properly, and offers decent protection while keeping the profile of the device somewhat sleek. this one works for me. love the durable feel to it, looks, and the included screen protector was a huge bonus! now, i purchased this case with the belkin 050. and i do have to say, i prefer the looks and feel of the 050 over the incipio. but i know if that one fails, ill be happy with this back up for sure.

So much better than the Speck CandyShells. As with all of the Speck CandyShells, the case eventually cracks above the USB port. Rather than replacing it with the same case (again), I looked for something else. I've used Incipio Featherweight cases on my BlackBerrys and thought they were great, so I gave this a try.The feel of the case in your hand is excellent, buttons are easy to press, and the case weighs virtually nothing and isn't bulky. The translucent back is awesome because the Apple logo shows through.I've dropped it a few times and the case did its job of absorbing the shock. Best case on the market for the iPhone, and an amazing price on Amazon as well (was roughly $9 when purchased, sold by Amazon.com).
This "case" is about as simple as they get. There isn't a whole lot of protection here, but you get what you pay for.
summary: This case is okay if you don't use your phone much..

reviewText: i have to admit this is one of the best cases i have had. i have been using it now for over a year and its still doing the job.

My search for the best "everyday" iP4 case may finally be over. After having tried several other cases (listed below) and reading reviews of even more, the Incipio NGP Matte is the closest to meeting my needs.Tested:* Apple Bumper- Minimal protection. Reports of scratching steel band and streching after continual use.* Griffin Reveal Etch- Very nice look and feel, but rubber sides were too loose for my liking.* Speck Candyshell- Confident about its protection, but too bulky, scratch-prone, and incompatible with most pin connectors.* Incipio Silicrylic- Precise fit and compatability. Silicone layer picks up lint (removed easily, but still...).Incipo NGP MattePros- Perfect fit.- Perfect balance of grip/slickness. Does not attract dust/lint.- Clean looks.- Does not hamper LED flash performance.- Easy to operate phone controls.- Superb compatability with 3rd party docks and connectors.- Material is tough to scratch.- Easy to install/remove.- Good size lip to lift front screen off surfaces.- Thick material provides both shock and puncture protection.- Compatible with screen protectors.Cons- Case shows marks from being removed from mold (some more than others).- Thicker than Apple BumperIf you can live with the slight blemish*, the NGP Matte provides the ideal balance between protection, size, grip, and function. It is easy to put in and out of pockets, provides excellent grip/feel without picking up unecessary dirt/lint and offers clean lines to enhance its attractiveness. The best "everyday" case I have tested so far.*Mold marks may even be removed with careful dremeling. Proceed at your own risk.

ive seen the pics of warping and problems with screen protectors--had had neither with this one. i love the NGP, the tactile feel of the whole case is great. i also really like that its one piece, instead of those two piece products by say case crown, or seido, or even otterbox. i cant say that this is THE best case, but its the best for my needs. not too large, and it provides decent protection...

I was looking for a simple case for my IPhone 4, that was light, easy to get in and out of my pocket, had decent grip, and would protect my phone from a moderate drop.  After reading many reviews, I chose this one.  After reading all the great reviews, I was disappointed by one thing.  The sides of the phone flex in and out when I hold it.  Other than this, the case suits my needs well.

reviewText: I had worn out my previous Incipio hard case for my little iPhone 4s so this was the replacement.Much better I think. Fits perfect and the fancy material the thing's made out of gives nice shock protection.looks good too as the iPhone itself is now visible whereas with the old hard cover it was not and the overall effect is very nice.Also fast excellent service and speedy delivery with excellent packing. Nice.

I bought this and the Magpul Case at the same time.  The magpul case beats this one hands down.  Don't get me wrong, this is a very nice, clean, well fitting case, but  it is too slick and not as light weight as the Magpul Case.

reviewText: Decent case. It looks like it would protect the phone well if you drop it. It goes on easily and is easy to remove. I found it to be too bulky and thought it turned a sleek and nice phone into a drab and bulky phone. I got it because I wanted a simple case that had raised edges to keep screen off the surface if you lay your phone face down. It looked sleeker in the pictures so I was very disappointed when I got this. The raised edges were a bit too high so my fingers kept hitting them when swiping the phone. I used it for a couple of days before I decided to return it and get the iFrogz Mix Case. The iFrogz looks okay (not great) but I still like the look and feel much better than the Incipio.

This is a good case providing very nice overall protection.  It has a good feel and fits the phone very well, not too loose, not to tight (difficult to get on).  It's almost exactly like the speck candyshell which was my favorite until I found this one except that there is no hard plastic, or candyshell, to it.  It's all hardened rubber.  GREAT!! This lack of hard plastic means 2 things to me.  (1) I have many chargers in many locations - car, bedroom, kitchen, work, mom's house, etc.  Some are fatter than the original apple plug and stretch out the opening on the candyshell case and eventually break the plastic at the opening by the connection port.  No plastic means no breakage.  Also since the hole for headphones is too small for anything other than apple brand headphones you may need to open the hole up a bit.  It's easier to trim the headphone hole for larger headphone plugs without completely damaging the case because there's no plastic.  I just take a knife and twirl it around in there to open it up then use a really sharp knife to clean up the edge a bit so there are no scraps hanging off.
summary: I've tested many and this is my favorite

reviewText: Based on what I saw online I was pretty excited about getting this case but then when I received this case I was not too happy. I was not too happy because this case seems like it will not protect the phone too much and if I drop it I feel like that is going to be the end of my iPhone. I am going to be ordering another new case because with this one I feel this is just plastic that is not going to last too long.

This is the absolute best phone case. It is sturdy, not flimsy, yet sleek and compact. Love the color options... I can't say enough about how great it is. I have the magenta and bought a black one for my bf. We both love them so much.

This is the best unibody case I have found iPhone 4S. It has a nice feel to it, it installs easily enough and it hugs the iPhone just right. It doesn't add as much bulk as the two piece silicone+hard shell cases out in the market, yet it provides excellent protection. I am hugely thankful that with Amazon's easy return policy I got to try a number of cases in my quest for the perfect one. And this one is a keeper. If you don't like bulky cases and want to protect your iPhone, this is the ticket....
summary: This case is perfect for me

reviewText: I have now owned FOUR cases for my iPhone 4-- a slim case by Cygnett (nice case, very little protection), the Splash Cruiser (hated it and returned instantly), the Contour Flick (love this company but my case was imperfect), and now the Incipio NGP.The polymer material it's made out of feels good in your hand, matte and not completely smooth, but not the slightest bit sticky. It also looks pretty sharp for just a plain black case.One complaint I have about it so far is that the sides don't seem quite snug -- the side of the case with the volume buttons doesn't fit perfectly and bulges out the tiniest bit which drives me a little crazy. I don't have the sense that the case is going to fall off my phone or anything, it just bothers me that it's not a perfect fit. I wish incipio had just left the rubber buttons off and let me use the original sexy steel ones, but that might be a personal preference.EDIT -- I also just discovered a cosmetic flaw which looks like an imperfection in the molding or whatever. Unfortunately I am going to have to return this case. I'm trying the Incipio EDGE next. honestly, I don't understand why it seems to be so hard to make iphone 4 cases without cosmetic flaws. I've seen them in 3 out of 4 cases so far.

Incipio is the brand that Verizon sells in their retail locations for 3x the cost.The fit: is perfect and all buttons that are covered work fine.  There is complete coverage on the back and there is a lip that just comes over the front.  This provides a nice lift so you can set the phone screen down and not have to worry about the glass hitting anything.  It also covers the edge of the screen protector I bought so hopefully it will prevent it from peeling at the edges.  All cutouts line up perfectly.  The speakers/charging port, headphone/mic port and silent switch are all uncovered.The material: is actually exactly what I want.  It's not the super pliable neoprene or silicone, nor is it a rubber.  It's more like a pliable plastic.  It provides good grip in the hand yet slides in and out of pockets easily.  Not too thick so it doesn't add bulk to the phone.***EDIT 20MAR2013***Just bought a pair of Magpul Field Cases for my wife and me.  Me in OD green and orange for her.  Although the Magpul is a great case, made in USA and army colors, it's just not quite as good as the Incipio.Incipio caseHas better volume buttonsHas better charger cutoutprovides a better lip for screen protectionThat being said, the magpul has the cool factor and so will replace the Incipio.

I guess I should count myself lucky - in five years of owning smart phones, I have not had a single cracked screen or (on the iPhone 4) rear glass. I thought that nothing had changed, until last week when I removed my phone from a different case for some cleaning. Much to my astonishment, a clean crack was running from top to bottom on the rear glass of the phone! I remember dropping it once, but with a hard plastic shell I thought no damage had been done. Not so, apparently.I immediately jumped on Amazon to look for a better case, and found this rubberized shell from Incipio. I have used their products before - I had a white case for a previous phone that simply got too dirty too quickly, but had since forgotten about their products. I wanted something that would be thick enough to protect the phone from any subsequent damage (silicone bumpers were out), but that would also not add too much bulk (Otterbox were also out). I liked the thicker look of the polymer used in this case, and decided to go for it.In the box was the case (of course) as well as several accessories that I hadn't even noticed would be included. A microfiber cleaning cloth was in the box, as well as a protective film for the screen, as well as a plastic squeegee to remove air bubbles when applying. The screen protector is one of the nicer ones I have used - it does not affect quality or tactile response, and when applied to a clean screen will leave no bubbles whatsoever!The case itself is a little thinner than I expected, but seems to offer superior protection. It is tougher than silicone but lacks the frictionless characteristics of rubber (try pulling a rubber phone case out of your skinny jeans....). That said, the polymer used is easy to grip, making it an ideal choice for people who tend to drop their phone, and yes, it is easily removed from said jeans! I was particularly pleased with the front of the case which has raised ridges above the screen. Measuring at around 0.1", they provide ample protection for the front of your phone without being too imposing. The raised covers on the buttons are easy to push, unlike other cases I have used.Overall I am very pleased with this case! It offers a nice all-around protection without bulking up your phone, and although it commands a slight price premium compared to other slim cases, it is still miles cheaper than other Otterbox-type cases. I am very pleased, and highly recommend giving the Incipio NGP case a try!

It's a nice utility grade case, especially when the price dips below $10.Medium thickness and protection.Not real grippy, not real smooth or slippery.Good finish and detailing, not superb.No interference with accessories or docks.If you hate paying a lot for a case, set an "Online Price Alert" that will email you whenever this or any amazon product dips below your target price. Google it. It's nicely done. Or try camelcamelcamel, which also shows price history.~~~ Comments & questions welcome ~~~===============================================

very nice case and fits well on the IPhone 4s,rubber lip on front is nice and thick (good thing)However it tends to be slippery in your hand.I'd rather have case that has more texture grip so it doesn't slide out of your hand.

My mom enjoys the case and it works well for her. Not that thick of a case so I would not drop phone on hard surfaces because I'm not sure how well it would protect the phone. Case is also made of rubber which is OK.

Love this case for so many reasons. It's just rubbery enough to protect the phone, but not so grippy that it prevents the phone from sliding into your pocket. Case barely adds any bulk to the phone, and the matte black gives it an awesome 'barely-there' look. Love Incipio.

THis case was as I expected. Very well made. Not too bulky and easy to install. I had an iphone 3S with the similar case and was pleased with it. I have dropped the phone several times with no apparent damage. It arrived promptly.

I had an OtterBox for my iPhone 4S and it was falling apart. I'm not in construction, nor am I rough with my phone, so I'm not quite sure how my OtterBox was falling apart within 6 months. I did some searching and decided to go with this case. I've had it for almost two months and I love it. It's not as bulky as the OtterBox, so you don't lose the slimness and the feel of the phone. i originally got this for myself but ended up giving to my wife. my problem with it is that on the long sides it isnt as snug as the top. this results in a bowed out appearance. im easily off put by that kind of thing and it was taking away from the whole sleek look and feel of the 4S. she likes it though.

reviewText: I like cases that are both slick and rubbery at the same time, and that is what this one is.  Its got a smooth, plastic like texture, which I like because it doesn't tend to pull everything out of your pocket when you pull it out.  At the same time, it has a nice, rubber like quality which feels like it gives the phone some protection.  Also important is the price.  I bought a similar product at the apple store for $35, so this was a steal on Amazon (with free Prime shipping).I am using it with the Verizon Iphone 4 and it fits just fine.  Perhaps the ringer/mute switch isn't perfectly centered with the case's hole, but it doesn't block and the volume up/down buttons also work fine too.

Just what I needed: a simple iPhone protector for wife's iPhone.  We really like the little ridge around face.  It's already saved her phone's screen from breaking when it fell flat on its face in the garage when she got of her car.  Not too bulky and easy to take on and off - phone is used to record lectures and the like at times which makes it necessary to take off as one of the microphones (side one) is covered by this case.  I'll probably just cut a little hole out with my drill to expose this second microphone.

Normally I don't take the time to review items, but I had my Iphone 4s for 1 day and dropped it. (gasp) With this case it did not have a scratch on either the phone or the case. I could not be happier with fit or function. Adds no real bulk, feels great and looks great. Using this in conjunction with media devil matte clear magicscreen protector. Note that it does not lift the protector once the protector is properly installed (protector must not foul the imperceptible lip around the edge of the screen). You cannot go wrong with this cover. Oh, almost forgot. I also bought the Seidio Spring clip holster and that fits this case perfectly.screen protector http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B003VPT5U2/ref=oh_o05_s00_i00_detailsholster http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B003ZB4H64/ref=oh_o05_s00_i02_details

I really like this case for the most part. The fit is perfect. It doesn't add a lot of bulk and doesn't warp or squirm away like some of the gel cases. The amount of stiffness in it is just right. The locations of the bumps for the buttons around the iPhone is perfect and the cutouts for the headphone cord and dock connector are clean and just big enough without being too big.What I don't like is the finish - it is very smooth and not very "grabby" and that makes me always feel like it might slip out of my hand.I really wish they had put some kind of texture to the surface of it. A cross hatch or ripple, or something. Anything would help to make it feel more secure in my hands.If you have dry hands or difficulty holding things this might not be the case for you.

Got this case because my daughter stole another Incipio case for her iPhone 4.  This case will work for either 4 or 4s model.  I buy cheap screen protectors over the internet.  Just be careful that you get the edges of the case over the edges of the screen protector.

No big deal here.  Its good but I haven't dropped my phone on a hard surface.  Not really anything to rate on but it was $10 not the $50 and above a lot of people are spending for a case.
Works like a glove. Fits very well and I like it. Should have purchased another one for my kids, but they need the Outerbox as they are tough on phones.

I purchased the black case. Its flexible, but its not like that silicone that collects lint. This does not collect lint, and it slides into your pocket really well. reviewText: I brought this for my daughter and she loves it but she really wishes that it came in more colors. I love the styling though and intend to use it more.

This cover really fits and protect my iPhone 4S. It's fantastic!It feels really well holding my phone. if you're really looking for a cover that really protects your iPhone, this is the cover I recommend you to buy. 5 stars!

The case fits (which is a good start) and the included display protector is decent.The reason for two stars is simply that the cutout for the phone ring/vibrate switch is too small lengthwise (e.g. does not extend far enough towards the volume buttons), making it hard to reach and use.The other Incipio case I bought for my fiancee's iPhone (in teal, not grey) doesn't have this problem; so I don't know whether I got a defective one or it's this particular case color's mold.

Not much more to say that others have not already. I like that this is a tight fit and tolerances on the openings is spot on. If necessary, I do believe that I could removed it and re-attach as needed. The rubber is thick, but not so much that it gets in the way.Highly recommended!

reviewText: This case is the perfect compromise of protection and sleek looks. The matte black finish on my black iPhone is sleek and professional, while also being thick enough to survive a little drop here and there (it has happened 2 or 3 times in 5 months).The material is more rigid than a normal TPU gel case, without being hard. The fit is very snug, to the point that it almost feels like the case is part of the phone. The lip on the front rises a couple of millimeters, so I feel comfortable sitting the phone down on a table without a screen protector. The Incipio lettering is so subtle you don't notice it unless you're looking for it. Port openings look clean and are well designed, fitting well into the overall design.A Few Minor Cons:The headphone jack is not large enough for a wide headphone jack like on my Audio Technica M30s, but that's true of most cases (Otterbox Defender Series being a rare exception). The seam from the mold is slightly visible on the sides, but no more so than on similar cases.
summary: Best Compromise of Protection and Sleek Looks

reviewText: This case is really sturdy, slim, and classy!  It protects the iPhone pretty well and the screen protector that came with it is also one of the best screen protector out there!
