reviewText: Before finding this product, the cases I tried either were too bulky or they fell apart after a couple months of use.  Its not like I was subjecting any of the others to a torture test.  They just were inferior.  This product looks good and stands up to normal wear and tear.
summary: Went through about 6 products before finding this: looks good and rugged

reviewText: Some reviews said people had trouble fitting it on their iPhone 4s.  Not sure why...It fits perfectly.  I got the trasluscent gray case and it looks and feels great.  Enclosed screen protector is garbage though....but I wasn't counting on that really being useful.Great case at great price.  Not sure why anyone would spend $30+ on case at Apple Store!

Perfect fit for my iPhone 4s, all the buttons function flawlessly. Does not add too much bulk to the phone like many other cases out there. Good grip to the case, but not enough to have a hard time getting it in or out of your pocket. It has a nice lip on the touch screen side to keep the screen from hitting the ground if/when I drop it. Definitely worth the $9.76 I paid for it to protect my phone from damage.

I just put this case on my iphone 4S and really like it.  The fit is perfect on the 4S with easy access to all controls, especially the off button on top.  It has a cut out for charging and it is a easy fit to dock it on the i clock radio.  No holding your mouth just right and using dock extenders.  Perfect.  I also like the texture of the case.  It has enough texture that it does not feel hard slick.  I purchased an Otter Box here on Amazon a week ago and I felt like it might squirt out of my hand every time I picked it up.  (See my review of the Otter Box for other comments.)  I have a touch of arthritis in my average sized (for a woman) hands and I  really appreciate feeling like I can hold on to the phone.  I have no idea how good the drop protection is and I hope I do not find out by dropping it. However, from all the reviews I feel like I purchased very good protection for my phone.

Case is inexpensive but vet effective and looks and feels great. The phone feels great in my hand. It isn't overly bulky and the bumper is big enough so that if you were to drop it the screen would be safe.

Nice case don't know how well it will protect during a fall.  Slips easily into your pocket as long as your not wearing skinny jeans.  A screen protecetor would have been cool but can't ask for everything.
I hate the bulky otterbox type cases, I want a very slim profile, but want a decent amount of protection.  This case fits the bill in all aspects.  Very happy!
Love these cases. Incipio has always been a trustworthy brand and this case is no exception. High quality and very protective.

The moment I put this case on it pressed up against the corners of my screen protects, you can see the edges coming up, do not know how long it would take the case to really ruin your protector, as I am not willing to find out.  I left it on for one day, thinking it would adjust or loosen up at bit, but the problem only got worse.  The case is nice, but I do not want to have to sacrifice my screen protector to use it.

It is a soup sandwich. It slips constantly, I used it for a day and took it off. Whenever I put it in my pocket, and then took my phone out, I'd literally take my phone out, the case would be on its own, either on its way to the floor, or hanging onto the bottom of my phone. Looks nice, feels nice, but will not protect a thing but itself.

This case really satisfies my needs.  I really like the look of the matte-black finish and the fact that it doesn't attract lint.  I wanted a case that would prevent scratches and minor dings, which this case does perfectly.  It is true that this case will not protect your iPhone 4 from large drops or water damage.  However, to me, it is not worth dealing with the very bulky cases required to offer this protection.  Instead, I got a two-year insurance policy from GoCare for $97 as a safeguard for such catastrophes.Edit:  I dropped my iPhone from waist height onto concrete and surprisingly the case completely protected my phone, no damages at all.

I've gotten compliments on this case. Slips on easily, feels good when you hold it. All the buttons remain accessible and clickable. Gives the moderate protection you need if you're not rough with your phone.
You get what you pay for not as good as my old Otter Box Commuter but does the job OK
summary: You get what you pay for

reviewText: I've dropped my phone at least 10 times. Basically no damage, though a particularly heavy drop caused some rattling of what I hope is just a chassis screw in one corner. I think this works better than the metallic covers because of the elasticity of the plastic.
This is a nice looking and very minimalistic shell that is relatively easy to install and remove. Great if you are looking for the least bulk possible.

Bought this to replace my expensive yet crappy Otterbox and I am so happy I did! It's not fancy but it does the job! I've dropped my phone about a million times on the hardwood floors in my house as well as outside when getting in or out of my car and my phone is just fine!
This is a very nice rubber protector for my sons iphone.  He's rough on phones and the case fits nice a snug so it will not come off.

I had a Griffin Etch Reveal case that I got free from Apple after buying my iPhone4 during the free case giveaway over the antenna issue, after a little over a year the silicone sides of that case wore down, ripped, didn't fit the phone anymore, etc.  I was in the market for a new case that was similar to that one but without the soft silicone sides that stretch and tear.  This Incipio had good reviews and was decently priced so I decided to check in out.  It is absolutely perfect for my needs.  Phone fits securely into the case, nothing is obscured by the case, adds a layer of protection to the back and sides without adding much weight or bulkiness to my phone, slips in and out of pockets easily - it's everything I need.  I love it.My only regret is that I was trying to get the grey gunmetal color which was sold out forever so I went ahead and ordered the black...now of course the day after I receive mine, they have the grey back in stock.  Oh well.
Very good case.  It has a good feel and protects the phone well.  It's also easy to put on a take off when necessary.  Very good case for the price.

My son is thrilled with this case. It has a great feel and allows access to all ports, it compliments the iphone rather than obcures it and it is very comfortable to hold and  provides solid protection.  This price is also outstanding. Highly recommend.

I like this case better than the Speck Candy shell even though I think the Speck may offer a little better protection (but not much more)- Speck Candyshell with glossy plastic finish scratches so easy and looks like crap within a couple of weeks.  This Incipio NGP is a matte plastic that does not scratch nearly as easily- Speck Candyshell and the Satin version front bumper around edge tends to come off in chunks when you take it in and out of pocket.  This Incipio case is all one piece so the front bumper around the screen will not tend to pull away from the rest of the case-  When I got my 2nd Speck Satin version I thought they had solved the serious scratching problem mentioned above, however after a couple of months, I have noticed all they did was spray the Candyshell case with a matte spray and eventually it starts wearing away beginning on the edges.  This Incipio does not have that issue.I do like the Speck but it just is not as practical as this Incipio NGP for a guy who keeps it in his pocket or lays it on a table back side down which 99% of people do every day.Pro's for the Incipio NGP- one piece design - installs easily and fits well.- does not make screen saver peel when installed- offers nice protection when layed on table screen side down- appears that it would fit in any docking station(although have not tried yet)- matte plastic material it is made from so far is scratch free after several days of normal use- the price was really right at less than $10Cons for Incipion NGP- absolutely none yet
summary: Incipio NGP vs Speck CandyShell or Satin for iPhone 4 & 4s

reviewText: Incipio is a great iPhone case company. Their cases never disappoint and you can find one for any specific need (low profile, shock absorbent, full protection, etc.) I bought this case for my father's phone and shortly after using it my mom and brother bought one of their own. It works very well and absorbs shock if you drop it. Personally I think that is the most important part of an iPhone case.The only downside is if you use a screen protector like InvisiShield this case will pry it up at the edges.
This may not work for you if you have a thick screen protector (especially those made of glass). I've had this for almost 2 years now and have dropped my 4S dozens of times. All is good!

I think there are very few covers that protect the iPhone as well as look good. This cover does both. It looks awesome and feels great in the hand and it is tightly fitted so it should protect the phone from a fall. All the spaces that need access are fully exposed and easy to use with the cover on.
summary: Fits perfectly. Solid build. Looks awesome.

reviewText: I love this case. All of the buttons are functional via the case and it is easy to get on and off without being too flimsy. I can put the phone on my charger with the case on. There is no reason to ever take the case off unless you need to use another case.

After about 3 months of use the rubber on this hardened up and made it really hard to get off. When I managed to get it off it was nearly brittle. Felt like if I dropped it with my phone in it, it would have cracked the case. Good for temporary protection on the phone.

I like this case oh so much! It is the thinnest lightest and toughest case I could find. It was also one of the more modestly priced. I never understood how so many people get the latest and thinnest iphone only to put it in a case that doubles the thickness and adds significantly to the dimensions! This isn't like that.Thin doesn't mean it isn't good protection. I've dropped my iphone enough onto pavement and concrete to test that toughness and it met the test. No problems and no broken glass.The texture of the case is nice in the hand. It's not so slipery as the naked iphone but it also isn't so tacky that it pulls everything out of my pocket when i reach for it.It's about as good as it gets with the tradeoffs inherent in iphone cases.
This was a present for my nephew when he first got his iPhone 4. It looked good and keeps protecting his iPhone very well even after years of daily use...

Originally I had Apple's inarguably over-priced, but well fitted and un-bulky bumper case on my iPhone 4. Over time the silicone peeled off the sides and, eventually, the plastic broke. Not willing to pay the premium for the bumper (got the original through the free case program), I purchased a cheap-o silicone case. And it was, well, cheap. Poorly fitted and constantly falling off, it became stretched out and unusable over time.This case fits very tightly, I like the smooth, matte finish and it manages to offer protection without adding too much bulk. Obviously not as sleek as a case-free iPhone, I feel like, especially with a child who loves to play with (and drop) my phone, a case is a necessary evil and, at least in my limited use so far, this seems like a good one.

AFTER ALL REVIEWS I WILL SAY BEST CASE ON THE MARKET FOR IPHONE 4 NOT 4SI HAVE RECEIVE IT,AND THE SCREEN PROTECTOR IS BETTER THEN THE ALL REGULAR OUT THERE.AND THE CASE IS OUTSTANDING COMFORTABLE ,FIT THE HAND OUTSTANDINGAAAA++++
summary: AFTER ALL REVIEWS I WILL SAY BEST CASE A+

reviewText: I love this Incipio case so very much! It is the perfect feel and protection and it is my favorite color! Turquoise! What more could I ask for? It is a gorgeous turquoise color. Not like the picture, but definitely what I would say is turquoise! I have yet to drop my phone with the case on but it feels like it would protect my iPhone for sure! I absolutely would recommend it to others!UPDATE: Drop my phone CONSTANTLY! I even hear gasps by nearby people when I do. Face down.. on the corner. Now, don't get me wrong. I am VERY protective of my phone... but this Incipio case does a BRILLIANT job protecting it! There is not a scratch on my phone *knock on wood* and I have had it for 8 months now! Seriously. Buy this case. I want it in every color. I wish they came in prints! Cause I would be ALL over that!! I just all around love it. Still do!

I have tried a number of cases for my iPhone 4 and this is by far the best. It feels good in the hand and maintains its' good looks after a lot of use. I liked it so well that I bought a 2nd one for my wife.
For my AT&T iPhone 4, it is a perfect fit. I don't know how it's gonna turn out in the long run, but so far, so good.

I have had several cases for my iPhone 4S and so far this one is the one I like the best. It is simple in design, one piece, designed to absorb shocks when the phone gets dropped, just enough lip on the front side to protect the screen when laid face down, just slick enough to easily slip into my pocket without picking up pocket lint, but not so slick that it is slippery and easily dropped just holding it.It seems to fit snugly enough that it isn't going to pop off, but not so tight that you can't use a screen protector.My only gripe is the screen protector that comes with the case.  It has a one-sided protector that you peal off to install which I have never been able to work without getting dust or air trapped under it so I chose to not use it.I would recommend this case to anyone with an iPhone.
Cheaper than i expected, but it is a nice case. Not bulky but doesn't look like it would offer a lot of protection.

This is great at protecting the phone, but it ends up being a little bulky. My tastes have changed over time, so I much prefer a thin profile case these days.Overall though, this is a solid case and protects your phone very well.

I love this case. I wish they'd find a way to make it hold cards. It feels great to the touch and it's been protecting my phone for over 2 years now. I've bought some for friends and family too. Although I've had mine for 2 years, it still looks brand new.

Everything that can been said about the case has already been said.  I'm entering this review just so that I can give the case five stars.  It is an amazingly great case.  It looks great, feels very comfortable to hold, and is very functional.  And, if I dropped the phone I'm sure it would be very well protected.  I'm using the case with the iPhone and placing it in the Seidio Innocase Holster. It's a great combination.  The iPhone is tightly held in the holster.  If you need a holster that clips onto your belt or waist and want to get the Seidio make sure you get the one that is not for a "naked" iPhone.  Get the one that is made to hold the phone with a case back since the clip that holds the phone in place is wider.
It fits well with my iPhone 4S and for the price it comes with a screen protector and a small piece of microfiber.
summary: Good fit and comes with screen protector and microfiber

reviewText: This offers nice protection from casual drops and scuffs, while keeping a slim profile. The pictures don't do it justice. All buttons and controls line up nicely, and the texture is smooth and dry feeling, not "grippy" but not slippery.I also bought the QuickFlipCase by Grantwood[...] so I could wear it on my belt, and the phone (with this Incipio cover) fits snugly inside the QuickFlipCase with just the right amount of "play" to allow easy removal. It's is a great combination.

This case was recommended by reviewers to be used with the Seidio Innocase holster for the iPhone 4. Sure enough, it's a great pairing. The NGP material is a little harder than I'm used to, but that's okay and it's kind of growing on me. The fit is perfect, and all controls are easy to use. The cutout at the bottom is big enough for even the bulkiest of dock connectors. My only slight dislike is the bevel around the screen edge. It's nice and high to protect the screen, but it's a bit "sharp". Combine that "sharpness" with the rigidity of the material, and it makes the phone fairly uncomfortable to press to your ear, especially for long conversations. It would be better if it were more rounded or flat or something, but it's not too bad as it is.Anyways, if you're looking for a good iPhone 4 case/holster combo, this is the way to go!

I wanted a case that was simple/not flashy, provides good protection without too much bulk, has good grip but not sticky, and allows easy access to all the buttons.  This case is perfect and fits like a glove.  I like that the screen area has a little lip that prevents the screen from touching the surface when placed screen side down.  Best case I've owned.

I bought this as a gift for my dad.  It was a good product.  Easy to put on and I do feel that it protects the phone pretty well (he dropped it a few times already) and the phone seems to be okay still.

reviewerName: Y. R. Wu "The will to win is nothing without ...
reviewText: Other than a small molding mark from where the part was injected, I'm very happy with the fit, finish, function and cost.This is a minimalist approach, adding very little in terms of weight and bulk.Even includes a screen protector, though will probably not use it since this case wraps around to the front, protecting the screen when placed face down.
summary: Fantastic case includes screen cover....Sprint Iphone 4S

reviewText: This case is soft to the touch, yet very firm and I feel will protectthe device if dropped, very well made and all ports and buttons lineup perfectly. Keeps a very thin profile and shape of the phone anda screen protector is provided as well. Available at a very discountedand reasonable price. Love it.

I spent a long time looking for the right case. In the end, there is no way I would ever buy a case that doesn't come around the front to provide some protection to the face. This case does everything you need. So far it seems better than the Apple case. I also purchsaed an Otterbox case and it is simply too big. Yes it will fully protect your phone but it adds significant size to it.It's hard to try all the cases but I would rank this up as one of the top choices for a lightweight, small, but durable case offering above average protection.

We were initially very pleased. The case fits very well, the color was vibrant and the protective aspect seems sufficient. However, after just a couple of days the case began to look very dirty. The case material absorbs the oils excreted from the user's hands. After only 6 days, my daughter was embarrassed to use the case. Because I was impressed by the excellent fit and apparent protective properties of the case we are going to try the same model in the darkest purple shade.Thank you.
summary: Good case if you don't mind how quickly the case becomes dirty.

reviewText: My wife really likes the case. I asked her how many stars and she immediately replied "4 stars because it gets dirty but cleans up well."

This case is very light but will still hold your Iphone very securely. The only objection I have to it is that the pink color gets very dirty from being in your purse. It's a magnet for dirt and we have tried everything to try and clean it and it still looks dirty.
summary: Average Case but still fits the phone very well

reviewText: Nice rubbery grip, not too thick, and thick enough to protect the iPhone 4 from most minor drops and incidental damage.  Not an Otterbox, but about 10 times less bulky than Otterbox as well.
I've already dropped my phone with this case on and it protected my phone, The case got a little scratch but nothing big!

Great case. I got this for my mom as a bday gift for her brand new iphone, and it is one of the greatest cases I've seen! Great material, soft plastic touch, protection around the whole phone, and comes on and off easily. The only thing is I wish they offered this case in more colors and designs!

This is the second one I purchase from Amazon. The previous one lasted two years. Actually, my wife still has the previous one but with time the shell got harder and now it seems to more easily slide off the right position and my wife finds helself pushing it back in some times. Since she likes the touch and feel of this case and in my opinion lasting two years is good enough for a case of this price I purchased it again. The case is exactly the same color, feel and shape as before and my wife is happy with it. I only gave 4 stars because it lasted only two years but I may be asking for too much considering the price it sells for.
This is a great simple case that allows use of the original volume and lock buttons on the iPhone while also providing protection for the phone.  Would definitely recommend to any other iPhone users.

Purchased this for my iPhone 4S.  Fits like a glove; all the buttons are fully accessible and the color is great.  It has a great feel -- just enough grip.  Would have given it 5 Stars, but I did have a problem fitting my car charge adapter in the bottom -- the adapter was a little bigger than the slot in the bottom of the case.  I actually took a small metal nail file and filed the opening -- took a little time, but it worked!  And it the case didn't crack or show any damage whatsoever; you can't even tell that I altered it.  The case is tight - so you need to be careful putting it on with a screen protector -- but it will go on.
Looks good. Do not have the phone yet. Feels hard and I think it will do the trick. No the best the price is correct.

This is a perfect case for the iPhone 4. It has a snug fit around the phone, and doesn't come apart on accident. My phone has been dropped three times, and the case cushioned the fall. The case did crack during those falls, but it protected my phone. The openings in the case for the side and top buttons are perfectly positioned. I have no problem with the rear-facing camera when using this case. The plastic is rigid but not brittle, and has a slightly grippy feel to it so it doesn't slip out of you hand, but it doesn't get stuck in your pocket.
This case offers protection for your iPhone. It is also very easy to put on and remove, much easier than a Gel type case.

Love this brand and style.  I have several others in different colors and patterns.  Hold up well and protects the phone great.  Keeps the back nice and shiny, not many crumbs or dust get through edges.
I loved this case. Didn't offer a whole lot of protection, but went on the phone nicely. Has a lip around the front screen preventing it from cracking.

I've had almost all of the major iPhone cases including the Otterbox cases. But out of all of the cases I've owned I love this one the best. It is functional, protective, sturdy, and stylish!. It is very solidly built and looks great, I highly recommend this case!
I didn't realize what I was getting for what I paid. My boyfriend paid 40-some-odd dollars for this exact same brand at the Verizon store. I definitely rubbed it in his face.
I don't know what to say this case is a dud. I am at a loss as I have a black one and it works fine. This purple case will not stay clasped and on the phone it keeps falling off. I am returning it.

I really liked the color of this case and the hard case but soft texture feel to it, however every time I would pull it out of my pocket (and sometimes purse) the bottom would slide right off. Why have a case if it won't stay on? :(
summary: bottom slips off when pulling out of pocket

reviewText: My wife purchased two of these.  One was two years ago and then again just recently.  She is not abusive to her iphone 4s, but she is relatively clumsy and does drop it from time to time.  After dozens of falls from various heights and on various surfaces the phone has no scratches, scuffs or cracks and works perfectly.  The case on the other hand did have some cracks and plenty of scratches.  That is why we purchased the same exact model again.  The case took the beating instead of the phone exactly like it's supposed to.  Great price, excellent protection and the thing fits perfectly without being super bulky.  We did notice a few changes from the previous version.  This one has better cut outs so that things like non standard ear phone plugs fit better.  I couldn't ask for anything better.
Broke the first time it was dropped - I get that the purpose is to protect the phone, but one drop rendering it useless is not a good bargain.

Like the color and texture of the case. The pearlized finish is starting to wear off on the corners but I'm sure that's to be expected. I can charge the phone without the case getting in the way. I'm glad I purchased the case, too bad it arrived the day after I dropped my phone face down in a parking lot. Thank goodness for skins (included with this case).
I bought this for my daughters iPhone and she simply loves. I have to admit, I sneak in her room to use it once and awhile.

Very good case at a great price.  It has a good feel and fits the phone well.  I love this case while it's on the phone, but it's very difficult to take off.  I've had to take it off to put on a screen protector.  There was a black gadget that came with it, but I couldn't figure out how to use it to 'slide' the bottom of the case off.

I loved the colour of the case and really liked it initially, but the colour soon faded and the case became dirty or at least looked dirty within a few weeks which unfortunately ruined the look. It has been lying unused since then because I cant seem to get it back to the original colour. Would have been a great product otherwise.. maybe black would be a better option for this kind of case, as it may not look as bad even if it does wear off.
summary: Love the colour but product faded quickly!

reviewText: This is a wonderful case! I feel like my iPhone is protected. The fit is snug and the deep purple is attractive. I like that the ports are all open.

This case is pretty cool... but it didn't fit my Iphone 4s all that well. Because the fit was so tight, I had to remove my screen protector, because the inner edges were lifting the screen protector off the glass. I didn't keep it to long after receiving it.
The non-slip backing came off after a month or 2 or gum workouts. It holds the Phones well and the key storage is really nice.

i know the case isn't supposed to be able to withstand a downpour but i though it would at least be able to shed sweat. the case literally soaks up the sweat from your arm and soaks the back of your phone with it. you would think a jogging armband would be able to line the back with something somewhat waterproof to shed sweat. if not, why not just put it in you sports bra?!

i use this almost everyday for 6 months, and it is NOT def 5 star productthe major issues1. not able to control the volume with side volume controller2. it is hard to rotate the arm band once it is on the arm - bc of neoprene sticks to skin3. the plastic clear cover turns "cloudy" / Opaque over time4. the arm band sometimes pinches the skin- ouch!
summary: the plastic cover gets opaque over time

reviewText: I was trying to find an armband that was fairly inexpensive and fit my iPhone 4 and I found it in this product. Great condition, reflective surface for night running and not too tight! Worth the money!!
this product specially made for those people that makes excersise and dont want to have the iphone or the ipad in there hands
bought for my daugther in law and she loves it. Runs and works out with her smart phone and even slips a key in the back.
summary: Bought for 40 year old and she loves it

reviewText: This is a great case at a fraction of cost.  It looks and feels great.  I would recommend!
The case is easy to use, but I question how much protection it provides.  It is better than no case but I prefer a more rigid structure.
I bought this case for my daughter to use until she got a Speck Candy Shell case she liked, installed on her phone. Everyone was impressed with it.

Bought this product for a friend and she is still using the same piece. It's worked out fine for more than 2.5 years!! Awesome. She did drop it couple of times but no damage. Good fit and very easy to install.
This product will cover your Iphone but quickly looses its elasticity and will begin to fall off of your phone within a month or two of using it.  It is cheap.
THIS REALLY WAS  JUST A LITTLE SHOT ON MY PHONE IT FIT BUT NOT COMPLETELY BUT GOOD PRRDUCT IF IT WILL FIT YOUR PHONE!!SHIPPING WAS FAST!! THANKS!!
summary: JUST OK IF IT WILL FIT YOUR PHONE

reviewText: Screen protectors do their job.  I like the way they also prevent others from seeing what you're doing from the side angle.  I do not like how the protectors become so dirty/cloudy over time.  I'm constantly cleaning them.

Love these. They are just like a mirror ! I can even put on lipstick using my phone for some help.  Have had a few ladies at work order them as well. The only draw back is the sun.. You cannot see the phone face in the sun at all. You must go to the shade. Not a super big deal for me but I have had a few very frustrating moments with it.
I'm enjoying the relection screen and also recieved a cleaning cloth with it.  The cloth is very helpful in keep the protection clean.
Very easy to put on my phone. Great protection only complaint is that it covers my front facing camera but it still works just a lil darker but that's ok! Other than that great product.
This product is great it fits perfect, took me one try to put it on, it works great wit the touch screen and don't worry bout being scared to buy its all good :)
just like the original one that I ordered a couple years ago from jawbone. works great and came with all the ear attachments as theirs did.
Blue tooth is nice but I could not get it to connect to my iphone.  Will need to read up on how to do it.  I am happy with product just need assistance learning how to use it.

I was looking for a bluetooth headset for my Galaxy S3 but I didn't want to spend a lot in the event I lost it.The Jawbone Icon was sent in a white box and in bags as another reviewer noted but it is not refurbished.Pros:Several earpiece options -Jawbone provides different ones for the user to find their best fit. Fantastic options and very comfortable.Lightweight and compact -I often forget I've got it on since it's so small and light, I haven't had my ear hurt from having it on all day either.Good battery life -I've had the unit for a week now and still have yet to recharge it.Loud when needed -Yes, if you're a little hard of hearing, it can get very loud if needed.Clear calls -Both receiving and placing calls are crystal clear.Cons:Single talk button -It can be a nuisance to some users that a single button does everything with no volume controls. I've found it easiest to control the volume from my phone.I highly recommend the unit and love it.

When I bought this headset I was concerned because there was only one rating; it was a five star rating, but still just a single opinion.  Well, I concur.- Pairing was a breeze.- Works flawlessly with two devices simultaneously.- Sound quality is excellent for both parties.- Actually works *well* at a distance.Then there's the online bit.  Jawbone has awesome service.  I downloaded Jawbone updater (for my Mac, no less), plugged the headset into my USB port, and updated its software.  I can also configure things like the name other devices see it as, which devices it has connections for, and even install a couple apps that enable things like voice commands.  Really slick.Lastly, the style is unisex; in spite of having "pearl" in its name, it looks fine for both men and women.I've owned like 10 headsets.  Prior to now my favorites were the Plantronics 925 and 975.  This devices sound quality is just as good, if not better.

A great product that fits snug in my ear. I have smaller ears so its hard to find an ear piece that fit comfortably, and Jawbone has done it right by providing two different ways to wear your Icon with different sized ear fits. Charges nicely, I can hear very clearly as well as the other person can hear me on the other end just fine. A great product!

The sound quality on the item is the best of three Jawbones I have had.  Battery life is great and it's super lightweight.  I got a great deal on this one and with free two day shipping it's unbeatable.
My husband has been using this for under a week and absolutely loves it. No problems what so ever. I am planning on ordering one for myself now.
Bought as a backup unit for my higher end Jawbone earpiece and this has not disappointed me.Came with all original parts and is perfectly new.LOVE it!

I've used this headset for some time now and I'm very impressed with it.  The noise cancellation is perfect, and I can hear perfectly clear through it.  I can whisper, or talk loudly and the other end of my calls never complain.  I would certainly buy another if I loose the one I have.

This is the first bluetooth I've had that the people I am talking to can't tell I'm on bluetooth - it sounds good to them.  But they sound a little tinny to me.  I don't really care as long as my business friends can hear me perfectly.

The Jawbone Icon is the best bluetooth headset I have ever owned. A long time ago, I used to have a Motorola bluetooth headset and I loved it. I purchased the H270 Motorola bluetooth headset and thought I would love it. I ended up returning it because the Jawbone is a far superior product. The Motorola only lets you hear phone calls through the headpiece and not any audio, such as iPod or videos. The Jawbone is an 'in ear' headpiece and the Motorla was not. I prefer the 'in ear' headset.Pros1. Very small and lightweight2. Talks to you and tells you how much remaining talk time there is3. Displays a battery meter on the iPhone next to the battery meter of the phone4. BEST FEATURE - you can listen to ALL audio through the headset, not only phone calls, including the iPod and any videos you are watching5. Very quick to recharge6. You can charge via USB on the computer or direct electrical outlet7. You can customize the voice that speaks to youCons1. Short battery life, approx 4 hours2. You have to push very hard to insert the USB connection to charge itBuy this product online here on amazon.com. It's for sale in retail stores at double the price!

This is wonderful technology, but it does not work with the included ear pieces.I tried lots of other ear pieces and finally had one custom made.  Lost that one too.I am trying this one more time with another custom ear piece.The noise cancellation is fantastic.  Turn your stereo up loud and people can't hear in on the other end.  They won't be able to hear anything on your end except for you.  I am eager to try these in high wind situations while sailing.  I can leave my phone in a plastic bag in my pocket and still receive calls.All it all a cool product, but it's fatal flaw are the ear buds, and these are very expensive.  They should partner up with some company that makes those since their buds are so horrible.
summary: Love it but it needs a custom fitted ear piece to stay in your ear.

reviewText: This is the third Jawbone Icon i've purchased from Amazon and every one has worked beautifully! They all came in the bulk packages, but everything was included that would have been in a retail package for less than $40!!  That's over half off you'd find at a retail store.
summary: Easy to use, great sound quality and design

reviewText: I love this little guy, It deliverers everything I want in a Bluetooth headset. First its easy to use. It has a simple on off switch. So easy. Second it uses a built in micro USB port for easy charging. Same plug for my phone will work with this headset. Third it has great audio performance. Another great little feature, it will tell you how much battery life is left. "3 hours of talk time remaining" that's just nifty! I lost this headset for almost a year 10.5 months.  When I found it again I literally screamed in joy!

I love these. Had one, used it till the battery finally stopped being able to hold a charge, and ordered another. Easy to use, stays in my ear pretty well. Comfortable in one ear for about 2 hours, then I switch it. Don't care about music streaming, but it does that.
This is a good sounding headset with great background noise blocking. The only thing I don't care for is that no matter what earbud I use it just doesn't fit too comfortably.

I will start with the cons, the reasons why I did not give this 5 stars.1. battery life dwindles with age, not a one-time purchase for life, but what is?2. twin mics get clogged with facial oil over time if you have oily skinPROS:1. small, SMALL, SMALL!!!2. BEST SOUND FOR YOUR CONVERSATION PARTNER BAR NONE! The noise cancellation really works and I can hold a conversation in the car with the window down.3. Best sound for you. Pair it withJabra Eargels for Aliph Jawbone Icon The Thinkerthe Jabra Eargels and you have a winning combination.  No ear clips.  Fits you well and you'll like no ear clips cutting into your ear like with many other brands and styles.Don't get caught  in a rainstorm though, these are NOT water proof.If you are looking for a smaller style BT headset, look no further.  Price is right.

I ordered this Jawbone as "bulk packaging" (comes in plastic bag) to save almost 50% from the retail packaging (boxed). The choice was a good one. The sound is very good, people tell me I sound much better than without the Jawbone, and the minimalist approach in the design is excellent. Other reviewer said his died after seven weeks. I just received it today, so I'll have to wait.....The pairing instructions enclosed in the tiny booklet manual were wrong. On my Samsung Galaxy Note I had to follow different steps than the ones described, in order to pair the phone with the Jawbone. I had to look up different blogs in order to find the correct pairing instructions for this bluetooth. Until then, I thought the unit was defective. The manual should be corrected with the right pairing instructions.Well, only time will tell if this Jawbone Icon will be reliable, or not.....

This is the previous generation of Jawbone Bluetooth headset. I think the most current one - by the time of this writing - is called Era. I however, preferred this one's design. It's smaller and very discreet. I have used it with two different iPhones (4 & 5), and it works pretty well. The noise assassin feature is very effective. People on the other side of the line have told me they can't tell I'm on a Bluetooth headset, and this is while having moderate surrounding noise (I haven't tried with heavy/intense noise, although in those circumstances I wouldn't even bother talking on the phone). Mine was a refurbished unit, but it works just fine.
summary: Small & discreet, nice performance and design.

reviewText: This is my second Jawbone Icon. I lost my first one and sought out Amazon for a replacement. The price was really good, so I checked the product description to make sure that it was new and not refurbished. Sure enough, the description says "new". Unfortunately, when the headset arrived, I noticed that there was evidence of earwax under the earbud. Completely disgusting. Also, when I took a magnifying loupe to the rest of the headset, I noticed that there was evidence of damage near the micro USB charging port, indicating that it had been used.DependableResource is engaging in deceptive marketing tactics, so please do not buy this headset from them unless you are okay with someone else's cruddy ear junk gettin' friendly with your ear canal. THIS HEADSET IS NOT EVEN REFURBISHED, BUT IS USED. IF IT WAS REFURBUSHED, SOMEONE MISSED CLEANING THE FREAKING EARWAX.Furthermore, this bulk packaging item came from DependableResource with only one earbud and was missing the large and small earbuds with the loops as well as the button-style earbuds. Not a huge deal to me, but it should be noted and should be advertised in the description.FYI, here is the product description:New Aliph Handsfree Bluetooth Headset Model # JBG03BD . The Jawbone ICON HERO is the smartest, most comfortable, and smallest Jawbone ever created. World's First Intelligent Headset Battery Meter for iPhone Your Jawbone ICON's remaining battery life is displayed on your iPhone's status bar Jawbone Talks to You Custom ICON audio tones whisper important information like remaining battery life and caller ID into your ear. . Jawbone Hero Bluetooth Headset. Black. ; Includes:. Headset ; Travel Charger ; User Guide ; Features:. Lethal NoiseAssassin eliminates noise and reduces wind ; Custom ICON audio tones whisper battery life and Caller ID ; Personalize your ICON with Audio & Dial Apps via Jawbone MyTalk ; Specifications:. Talk Time (maximum) Up to 4.5 hours ; Standby Time (maximum) Up to 250 hours ; Version # 2.1 + EDR ; Range (feet/meters) 33/10 ; Weight: 0.32 oz; Compatible With:. Bluetooth enabled devices such as mobile phones, PDAs & computers that support Headset and / or Hands-free profile;The Icon is the best bluetooth headset I've ever used, but it still could be refined. It seems better than the original Jawbone and is far less bulky. The battery indicator for my iPhone works well, and I like that I can charge it via any USB port. Sound quality is very good but not perfect. When I'm in my convertible (top up), I have to drop my speed to below 60mph so that people can hear me, so the Icon has trouble with the wind noise from the soft top (or less than airtight windows).I like the fact that it doesn't require a fragile and hard to put-on ear loop. Some other reviewers complained about the standard ear bub hurting their ears after an extended time; I agree with that assessment.
summary: Great headset but not new. Do NOT buy from DependableResource unless you want used EARWAX; item is USED (not even refurbished)!

reviewText: This product works just as advertised.  It's easy to pair to my bluetooth devices and stays connected when I'm as much as 30 feet away.  It announces the callers number very clearly each time I get a call.  I wish it announced the name but it wasn't advertised to do so.  Once you get used to listening for the number as soon as your phone rings, you'll get used to paying attention to the announced number.  Overall I'm very happy with it.
summary: It works great for what it's made for

reviewText: ; MYTALK brings Jawbone Icon to life; personalize your experience online with an array of apps  POWER AND BATTERY On/Off Switch; Up to 4.5 hours talk time; Up to 10 days standby time; Battery life is displayed on your iPhone;s status bar; Built-in rechargeable Li-ion polymer; MicroUSB standard connector interface; BLUETOOTH Bluetooth V2.1 compliant; Supports Enhanced Data Rate (EDR);
summary: MYTALK brings Jawbone Icon to life

reviewText: Previous ones were lost.  My favorite.  Easy to forget you have on and the sound is loud, clear and reception of your voice on the other end is fantastic.  No one ever asks me is I am on Bluetooth or speakerphone.  They can't tell.  Battery life is fantastic too.  Lasts for days, in or out of use.
summary: Second or Third I have purchased

reviewText: The length of the cable makes it worth every penny. It is also very well put together. I highly recommend it.
summary: Why did I wait so long to get one?

reviewText: Apple makes the most unbelievable products hands down... Their powering stations though, suck... This is the worlds best cable charger!!

This is my second purchase. The first lasted a year before the connector broke. But being as it was an excellent product I want to purchase a replacement. Purchased and shipped from Amazon LLC. The connectors are different. Pictures coming soon. Self explanatory. Biggest gripe is that with the back cover on the iPad the connector no longer fits.Now it's possible that Griffen cheaped out the second production run. But i have found conterfit products making their way into Amazon LLC. before. Very convincing. Security stickers and all.I'm checking into this one. Kinda hope Griffen didn't cheap out. That will be disapointing.Amazon customer service is the best.I will update soon.

Great cable.  It does exactly what I want it to do.  The only caveat I have is that if you are using a bulkier case, or one with a smaller port through it for the synch cable you won't be able to plug this cable in without distorting the case a fair bit.  I use a Griffin Survivor case and without an adapter like this one:B0081OKNVIyou'll have trouble reaching into the ipod's socket.  Besides being a heavier duty cable and casing the end that attaches to the ipod socket does not have the spring loaded hooks that I hated on my original synch cable.  fewer moving parts is fewer parts to fail (seen through the eyes of an engineer).  good quality cable.
summary: long heavy duty Ipod synch cable

reviewText: after a month or so it did not work anymore, looked like high quality product but never worked again, get the real one.
summary: You get what you pay for

reviewText: Got this for my husband who was complaining that the cable that came with his iPad was too short.  This one is really nice and beefy, and long enough, so he really liked it at first.  But then he started having trouble with it falling out of the connection port, just because it IS so beefy.  He has since bought yet another cable because this one wasn't exactly what he wanted.
summary: Cable is just a little too heavy

reviewText: This cable has the thickest connector end that I've ever seen.  It doesn't fit through the hole of my iPhone case, and it won't fit through most other cases either.  This makes the cable useless for me (unless I were to remove the protective case).  If anyone knows where to buy an extra long cable with a -thin- Apple style connector, which is of decent quality, please post your suggestions.Update: instead of searching for a long iPhone cable, I purchased a USB extension cable - the Cables to Go 6 foot USB extension cable.  Why didn't I think of that before?  Just use the normal short cables with thin connectors and make the USB part longer.
summary: Not for iPhones with cases (with most case designs)

reviewText: Appears to be of solid construction. Cord is long enough to let you use the phone while it's charging without sitting at an awkward angle to reach an outlet. Also great if you have a long way to reach on the USB port of your computer. Only catch is, if your like me and have a bulky case like the Otterbox Defender, you have to take the case off to  use it. The device end of the cord is a bit too thick. I like the design of the cord well enough that I'm going to keep mine and try a piece of sand paper to reduce the connector size on the cord.
summary: May not fit with some cases.

reviewText: I bought one of these for use with my iPad. The cable that comes with the iPad is short (just a little over 42" long according to my tape measure), and so thin it looks fragile. I tried using it with the adapter plugged into an extension cord so I could comfortably use my iPad in bed while it's plugged in, but this was more hassle than it was worth. Plus, I wanted to have an extra cord so I could leave one (the 42" one) attached to a desktop for use whenever I need to sync my iPad.Griffin's 3 meter (approximately 9 feet) long cable looks and feels rugged, it does not kink up on me (unlike a long, cheap USB extension cable I own), and its length makes it easy to use my iPad on AC because with 9 feet it's usually easy to reach an outlet (and one can still use an extension cord if 9 feet isn't long enough). That's it. I didn't buy it for syncing, just so I could use AC without having to use the short cable that comes with the iPad. The cable is warrantied for a year and it certainly looks like it will last a long time if not mishandled. There is an amusing, entertaining albeit not very informative 3-minute long video about this cable at the website for Griffin Technology. The video doesn't convey any information about the cable you don't already know by virtue of the fact that it's called the 3 Meter USB to Dock Cable, but the video says something about Griffin's sensibility that I like.The part of the cable that plugs into the iPad is thick - 3/8" versus less than 2/8" for the cable the comes with the iPad by my measurements. I can get it to fit through the opening around the power/sync port on a Simplism brand iPad skin that I own by stretching the silicone a bit, but after doing that once I got the sense that doing that regularly would leave the silicone stretched out, so now I remove the skin when I use the cable. I also own a folding case for my iPad that is completely open at the top, bottom, and one side, and so using the cable when my iPad is in that case is not a problem. The cable's nice looking, too.(I bought mine at the local WalMart, where with tax it came out to cost a little less than I would've paid at Amazon - I'm in a state where I have to pay Amazon sales tax, plus I know from experience and I asked to double-check when I bought the cable, that if I wasn't happy with it and didn't destroy the packaging, I could return it for a full refund with no hassle, and of course no return shipping cost. Had I taken that chance with Amazon, I would understandably have to pay return shipping if I decided I just didn't like the cable.)
summary: Pricey for a cable but worth it to me

reviewText: I couldn't get the first two Griffen 3 meter iPhone/iPad cables I bought to stay connected. I contacted Griffin's Customer Service in february 2012 and they promised that the cable with an improved connector end would be available in April. After waiting two months I received my replacement cables.  I've been using them for two weeks and they have the very same fault...the slightest movement of the device and they dislodge. It's too bad because the heft and length of the cable seemed to promise a superior product.  But If I wanted a cable that would only work when I'm not using the device, there are a lot of cheaper cables to chose from.
summary: Loose connector on all four cables I tried.

reviewText: I've been using the same Griffin 3M cord for maybe four years, just now getting around to reviewing it (I thought I already had).  It is sturdy, it fit just fine in my otterbox defender, with a solid, strong connection.  I like this cable so much that when I upgraded to a new iPhone, I bought an adapter so that I can continue using it with the new lightning connector.  It's great for sitting a distance from the plug, like when you're on the sofa, in bed, or at the airport.  I bought a couple of cheap 10 footers for my kids, but they only lasted a few days before either the data or the power stopped working.

I got this item in order to be able to use my iPhone 4GS in the middle of a room without draining the battery.  So far, no problem.The issues that I have that prompt me to return the item have to do with its weightiness.  To be fair, it is advertised as being heavily insulated.  However, the cable far outweighs the phone itself which makes the phone hard to use.  Additionally, the Apple proprietary plug is so thick and heavily built that it cannot be mated to the phone with a phone case in place.Interestingly, for all the heavy construction and insulation it still results in feedback hum when the phone is used with external audio speakers.
summary: Too heavy in too many ways!

reviewText: It worked maybe only two months before it wouldn't connect to the ipad anymore. The connector end kept popping out and if I wasn't physically holding it into my ipad, it would not charge. That being said, I don't recommend this product at all. It is pricy and breaks easily. I would recommend the extender from the apple store instead. I have used that now for quite a while now and it is still as strong as the day I bought it,
summary: Worked for a little while before it just stopped

reviewText: It works, but I do not like that the head of the cord is so thick. I wish they would have made it the same size as the standard iPad cord so that it fits on your devices properly.

This cord is the answer to the inconvenience of the short cord that comes with the iPad.  Although I use the short cord when I'm right next to a plug in (right next to my computer), I use this quality long cord for everything else.  It really is high quality compared with the short cord that comes with the iPad.

But alas, it's too good to be true. A quality cord that Apple itself sells at its stores which is where I bought mine for my iPhone 4s. I have a Speck Candy shell case on my phone. The Speck is designed for a wide port so that it's not exclusive to only an Apple cord. I use the Amazon Basics cord and a Griffin car charger with my case. This cord does not fit unless I take my case off. This is not feasible to do every night when I charge it overnight and play games in bed before I fall asleep. This would put wear and tear on my case and phone. I have to return the cord and I'm back to where I was before I purchased it. I guess I need to go buy a new extension cord even though that wasn't convenient.
This thing is awesome. It's extremely tough and it reaches anywhere I need it to. If your i-device takes the 30 pin stop reading this and buy it
summary: What the apple cord should be

reviewText: This is strong and solid cord.  I highly recommend it.  If you need something strong, then get this one.  If you have a case though that has a small opening for where it would go, then you might not consider this.  If you have an InCase like me (Snapon one, I think it is called), then this is great!

It has only been a few months, however, the reviews from other users look promising.  For one it is much thicker and seemingly better shielded than other cables I have used.I have not experienced any issues with the USB end not staying in a charging adapter.  Any reviewers claiming this issue may want to try different adapters to isolate the problem.It does what it is supposed to do: Charges my iPhone or iPad and gives more room to move while charging.
Griffin On Top  always we can say for this company product i love it i like it , Best Of Best

The cable itself is very nice, thick and insulated.The length is great, its only weakness is right where the cable attaches to the connector, it should have a much longer piece that sticks out so that the cable can go much further into the connector.This is our 2nd one, first one lasted about 1 year before the cable just finally frayed and separated away from the connector.On this one I took my fly tying gear and I wrapped lots of thread around the connector and to the cable making that joint MUCH more solid, then coated it with nail polish.It is now the way it should have been to start with with no weak points.I added a picture under customer images to show what I feel needs to be done.

I got this for my iphone 4S after reading the glowing reviews.Yes the cable is thick and sturdy.BUT, the plug that inserts into the bottom of your phone or ipad is so thick that you cannot use this with many cases such as the ubiquitous iphone bumper from apple.The plug also will not fit in my ipad with the case on. I haven't tried it with every case on the market, but it really should work with the ones sold by apple.So, you must take the case off your ipad or iphone to use the cable with is annoying and inconvenient.The people who designed this should realize that people will have these incredibly common cases and that the plug should be slimmer so you can charge it with the case on!
summary: FRUSTRATING! Doesn't fit with a case on your phone or ipad.

reviewText: I ordered two of these cables and neither work. I have 2 iPhones, 2 iPads, and 2 iPods and it won't charge any of them. It says it is charging for about 10 seconds and then the devices keep making the "plug in unplug" sound. I'd have to rate these as junk

I bought this because I needed a longer cable to connect to the charger that came with my iPad 2. Although advertised to charge the iPad, this cable does not. My iPad won't even recognize it.  Also, be advised that if you have ANY kind of case that obscures the dock connector, you will have an almost impossible job of trying to connect this cable. The dock connector on it is too fat. Actually, this is mostly Apple's fault. The new slim design makes inserting any cable rather difficult because the dock connector is at an angle now. As much as I wanted a longer cord, this isn't it.

I bought this since the table where I keep my iPad is too far away from any outlet.  The cable is thicker than any recharging cable I have.  The connector is also substantial.  It has proved to be a very good choice for me.  It is long enough and appears sturdy enough to last for a long time.

To test my Aircurve, I chose Yello as the artist and let Pandora play on the high quality streaming setting.  Had this horn been able to amplify the full range of sound from the deepest bass to the highest of the sparkling highs would have been nothing short of a miracle.  While that didn't happen, the range of sounds that my 4S speaker is capable of producing were evenly "amplified" to a surprising amount.  I did notice that if the Aircurve was stood on it's side with the opening for the sound near the countertop that the "bass" produced was marginally deeper - I'd compare it to what I've heard out of small battery amplified travel speakers.If you are looking for an easy, battery free way to make your iPhone (4 or 4S) louder, this is a great accessory.  If full range sound that really fills a room is your goal, you should probably be looking into the powered speaker category and plan on spending at least 4 times what the Aircurve Play costs.
summary: A great product that does exactly as promised

reviewText: This Thing is wireless and amplifies the sound on the Iphone 4 like a charm! it is LOUD! I now need one for my Ipod Touch 4g, the bone one is ridiculous expensive compare to this, so griffin I'm waiting on you guys!

I recently ordered and received the Aircurve Play for the iphone 4. As others have stated, the phone fits loosely within the Aircurve unless placed in the provided white case or you have a case of similar thickness.  The case I already have on my iphone fits well enough, so no need to switch cases, I can just drop it in the Aircurve and it works (I think most thin cases would probably fit well enough).  The device certainly results in a noticeable increase in volume, though it would not really be audible during a party or after walking into other rooms of my house.  It is loud enough that I clearly hear my iphone while using the shower.  The sound quality is about what you'd expect from something that just amplifies your iphone speaker, slightly degraded from the normal iphone speaker.  Due to the limited increase in volume and sound quality, it's not something I'd use while entertaining guests. My sole purpose for purchasing the product was to place it in the master bathroom so that I can listen to my iphone while getting ready in the morning (hear the speaker over running water), and for that it works perfectly.  No cords or batteries to ever worry about either!Depending on your intended use, this might be great or horrible.  If you're an audiophile or intend to make this a primary listening device, you may be disappointed.  If you just want something cheap and easy to slightly amplify your iphone speaker and don't want to deal with a cord or batteries, you could be very happy.

I was looking for something cheap and easy to allow me to listen to audiobooks or music in the shower and things like that. Most portable speaker sets are rather expensive.This amplifies more than I was expecting, and is nice and small. It's easy to find a place to put it that doesn't endanger my iPhone, and I don't need to run any power cords in the bathroom or charge it.The sound quality is about what you would expect: same as the built-in speaker only louder.

reviewerName: FMatta "My Mac and Amazon is Happiness"
reviewText: The Aircurve Play for iPhone 4 is perfect for the office (i work on a cubicle).Here are the things I love about this item: No power required, good sound, smart design, can use on landscape or upright, quality item with good price. I love how the item has the rubber insert for the iPhone without a case, and even better I love how I can just remove the rubber insert and slide in my iPhone with my incase and griffin cases and the fit is just right. Sometimes I take this home with me, and it has a good sound even in more open spaces like my living room or the balcony. Since the aircurve is very portable I'll be buying a second one of this to keep with me at all times.
summary: great value for a great product

reviewText: Works very good but had to take phone out of case ever time I have otter box so it was very hard would not buy again

I don't know how it works but it's exactly what I wanted.  No wires, nothing to plug in at all except your iPhone charger, if you want.  The frame is heavy duty acrylic and when the iPhone is placed on the white pad, voila, the sound becomes instantly louder!  I like to listen to my iPhone with my bluetooth while driving but there are times when my hubby and I like to listen to Sirius Satellite Radio together.  Unfortunately the volume isn't loud enough, especially in faster traffic. The Aircurve Play solves the volume problem and is loud enough to hear spoken words.  The quality isn't great for music in my opinion but it's the best for podcasts, GPS directions, audio books, etc. You can't find anything better for the price. I agree with another reviewer that the Aircurve makes the phone much easier to hold and the wire stand is similar to a how a picture frame stand works.  I hope they make some sort of dashboard mount!  Fingers crossed!

On my old iPod, I had a silicone case because hard cases scare me a little since they don't absorb the shock of dropping the iPod. However, silicone cases leave these weird marks which are impossible to get off and that ruined the back of my iPod. For my iPhone, I wanted something that had the best of both worlds so I decided to go with this. It's amazing. It's an rubbery in-between material that's flexible but pretty hard at the same time. I would recommend this to anyone with an iPhone 4. It's also not bulky like many other cases I've seen. Doesn't add much thickness to the phone. I think it's better than most $30 cases I've seen and at only 1/3 of the price! I'm very satisfied.

Really liked the design and quality of the sleeve. It's like a jelly one that stretches over the phone. I thought it was a hard case that snapped on in 2-pieces, but whatever! I like it! I like the price :D

This MiniSuit case is the 3rd case I purchased from Amazon over the past 3 weeks after getting my iPhone 4.  I can honestly say that it is by far the best one.  I also owned a Sonix Snap Slim case (a good choice but a bit slippery) and a MiVizu case (a poor choice because it's rubbery and loose fitting).The MiniSuit case fits snugly (but not too tightly), it feels nice to hold (not sticky or slippery), and although it's 'smoky' in color, it's partially see-through so you can see the Apple logo on the back and the metal on the sides.  I'm personally not crazy about the concentric ring design on the back, but to me it's not offensive.Even though the "+" and "-" buttons (as well as the power button) are covered, they are still easy to press through the plastic.  The headphone opening on top and the camera/flash openings on the back are well placed and don't interfere at all with function.I'm not really sure what TPU plastic is, but whatever it is, it makes a very comfortable, stylish, and functional phone cover.  Good job all you guys at MiniSuit!  You have a new customer for life!
summary: The best case I've found so far!

reviewText: received fast.  good product for the price.  if you have any other type of protector on the screen, it takes a little adjusting to fit just right (not a fault of the product).  it's durable and feels secure.

I can be a picky buyer.  I can certainly call myself a good judge of product quality.  As far as what I am looking for, this is just about everything I need in a quality slim case for my iPhone 4.  First of all, it is much more attractive in real life than what you see in the photos.  It definitely exceeds my expectations aesthetically.  It also is very functional.  Good fit, good feel, and not too loose.  The case is very slim so when I stick my iPhone in my back pocket, I often forget that it is even there.  I have also dropped my phone and the case protected it from damage (not a big fall, but still a drop from about 4 feet to the tiled floor).  So overall, I am a happy owner of the MiniSuit iPhone 4 skin case.  Five Stars!
summary: Just about as good as it gets

reviewText: I absolutely love this case. It fits perfectly and has a nice, smooth feel that's not too slippery nor too rubbery. The only reason I held back from giving it 5 stars is that the opening for the ringer switch is not perfectly aligned. But for this price, who cares?

I initially bought this case from the cheapest Amazon 3rd party company that sold it. The bottom portion of the case fit poorly. Poorly enough that one of the corners of my iphone would slid out over the protective covering. Either my case was defective or the case was just poorly designed. The case was too cheap to bother shipping back for an exchange.I ended up ordering another case using Minisuit as the vendor for a buck more. This time the bottom of the case fit as snugly as the top of the case. Excellent case if your looking for something slim without resorting to a bulky case that defeats the purpose of the iphone design.

This rubberized case fits very well, though all rubberized cases take a little work to get everything on & aligned properly.  The rubber is clear enough that the design on the back looks pretty interesting.  It will protect the phone from a drop better than some of the thin profile snap on cases I'd say. It is rubbery for group but isn't as soft as silicone and doesn't attract lint as much.Positives:Fits really wellEasy to installInteresting back designAvailable!Negatives:Takes a little work to get it to look installed perfectly like a hard shell case, as does any rubberized type case.The lock button takes some work to make the indention align with the case, or at least during my install.For those who like the rubberized type case, this one is perfectly good without any significant design issues or problems. I love reviews that destroy a product simply because people don't take the necessary precautions nor time to figure out something for themselves. Any phone that requires this adapter obviously should be used with a standard SIM card...and if you use anything else you are assuming some responsibility for your device and any subsequent failure.But, I digress and stand down from the soapbox.These work. They do what they are supposed to and don't take a enormous amount of time, effort nor thought to use properly.And...to remove them, take a moment, study your device and...wait for it...BE SMART.Here is the problem most people seem to be having: The contact pins in many phones were designed to accept a standard SIM. With this in mind the adapter (any adapter) cannot make up for the small gap that will exist between the SIM and the adapter itself. I don't care what you use or do, this is not something that can be helped.So here is the safe way to remove the device from most phones. Obviously I only have a limited number of phones I can test this on and you should take some time to study your particular device to see if this will work. I take no responsibility for any problems.Cut a small piece of plastic longer than a SIM but close to the same width. I used a piece of screen protector film with the peel away backing still in place. Such a film is flexible and thin enough to slide between the SIM and the contact pins. You need something this thin because you are going to use it to help assist your SIM with adapter into place and out of your phone if you are removing it.The idea is simple: use this film to push down the pins and to provide a safe insertion and removal. For my wife's blackberry and Galaxy Note I placed the thin piece of film into the SIM slot. Then I inserted the SIM and removed the film. This ensures that the SIM is seated properly in the phone. If you want to remove the SIM you simply insert the film BENEATH the SIM card, push all the way to make sure it is under the SIM completely and between the SIM and the contact pins. Gently remove your SIM while keeping the film in place. Do this right and your card won't rip the contact pins from your phone.Not brain surgery. Just a few moments of thought.
summary: They work..With a 2nd grade IQ you can remove them too! READ FOR INSTRUCTIONS ON REMOVAL

reviewText: I had high hopes for the Captivate. I had to upgrade from my Motorola Backflip which if you think the Captivate is memory bound just look at the Backflip. Having seen a Captivate from a person in the seat next to me on the airplane I knew it was the phone I wanted to move to.It wasn't until I got the phone that the one feature I depend on as a road warrior, GPS, doesn't work well on the Captivate. Getting a GPS lock takes time. Tracking while moving in a vehicle and it can't keep up. I tried all the "settings" people posted which basically only helped the initial lock time from minutes to less than a minute. Tracking is useless. Since I truly love the other features of the phone I sprung for a GPS dongle which hopefully will resolve my GPS issue. But a phone as expensive as the Captivate it should have GPS working out of the box. Even the Motorola Backflip GPS works better than the Captivate which is sad. On the Captivate I tried Google Maps Navigation, Waze and CoPilot Live which all worked just fine on the Backflip on the same streets I've tried the Captivate out on.Otherwise all the great things people have posted about the screen are true. Memory wise it is way better than the Backflip and the processor is loads faster. Photos are amazing even without a flash. Haven't done a video yet.But I can't recommend this phone due to the poor quality GPS. Even rooting and installing Android v2.2 (Cognition ROM v2.3b8) made no difference to navigation.  The lock is slightly faster but it just does not keep up on the road.  You need a GPS dongle (see below) to get navigation to work.  I used the Google Navigator application but Waze and CoPilot Live both exhibit the same behavior with the built in GPS.[Update: Jan 7, 2011] Received the GlobalSat BT-395 from Amazon and it works with the Captivate! Download the free "Bluetooth GPS" application from Android market and use that to connect to the 395. This has made the Captivate function as a navigation device... finally. Though I do have the downside of having to carry yet another device in my jacket pocket and remember to charge it up every so often.I also happened across an issue of Consumer Reports yesterday that ranked the Captivate right behind the iPhone 4. This is another reason I've stopped relying on Consumer Reports. They rated the navigation on the Captivate as "Very good" when it is not.[Update Jan 19, 2011] Knocked it down to one star because GPS does not work for navigation on Android v2.2 using the Cognition ROM. I do not recommend people go down this path unless they are highly technically skilled. But it doesn't fix anything. The lock time is faster than stock but navigation is still too far behind to be of any use. This looks like a hardware problem. Avoid this phone if you need to use GPS for navigation (unless you invest in a dongle like I did).
summary: Don't get this phone if you need it to also handle navigation
